66472.recognize_zh: 視野中可見數顆大型、核形不規則且有折疊或腎形凹陷的非典型細胞，細胞質豐富，夾雜嗜酸性球與泡狀背景；這種大型多形性細胞提示間變性大細胞淋巴瘤 (ALCL) 浸潤，但須靠 CD30／ALK 免疫染色確認。
features: Scattered large atypical cells, several times the size of adjacent small nuclei, with abundant pale to amphophilic cytoplasm
Pleomorphic nuclei with irregular, folded to reniform contours; a few show nuclear grooves or indentations suggestive of horseshoe forms
Vesicular chromatin with inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Admixed eosinophils with red-orange granular cytoplasm and small lymphoid and stromal nuclei
Vacuolated, edematous or poorly fixed background; image is soft-focus, limiting nuclear detail
66472.describe_en: Section of bone marrow shows an infiltrate of large pleomorphic cells with abundant cytoplasm and irregular, folded to kidney-shaped nuclei with vesicular chromatin, set within a vacuolated background containing scattered eosinophils and small lymphoid cells. Definite hallmark cells with classic horseshoe nuclei are suggested but not unequivocally resolved at this image quality, and no cohesive sheets of normal hematopoiesis are apparent in the field. The morphology is suggestive of marrow involvement by a large cell lymphoma such as anaplastic large cell lymphoma; confirmation requires CD30 (strong, uniform), ALK and T-cell marker immunohistochemistry together with cytokeratin and melanoma markers to exclude metastatic tumor.

ddx.vs: Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are rare cells with large inclusion-like nucleoli in a mixed inflammatory background and are CD15+, PAX5 weak, whereas ALCL cells are more numerous, CD15 usually negative, PAX5 negative and often ALK or EMA positive.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters with cytokeratin positivity and is CD30/CD45 negative.
Melanoma may show pigment and prominent nucleoli and is S100/SOX10 positive but CD30 and T-cell marker negative.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant
ddx.vs: The anaplastic variant of DLBCL is CD20 and PAX5 positive, whereas ALCL is a T/null-cell lymphoma lacking B-cell markers.

66344.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下可見兩個邊界清楚的圓形類上皮組織球團（epithelioid granuloma），外圍有小淋巴球環繞；但此放大倍率下中央未見明確的無細胞嗜伊紅乾酪樣壞死，是否為乾酪性肉芽腫需以高倍確認並做抗酸染色。
features: Low-power trephine with bony trabeculae, fat and hemorrhagic, variably cellular marrow
Two well-circumscribed nodular aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and elongated nuclei
Peripheral cuff of small lymphocytes around the granulomas and an adjacent lymphoid infiltrate
Central caseous necrosis is not clearly identified at this magnification; no definite multinucleated giant cells resolved
Residual hematopoietic elements scattered between fat spaces
66344.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy at low power shows two well-formed, circumscribed epithelioid granulomas composed of histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and elongated nuclei, rimmed by small lymphocytes. The intervening marrow shows fat, hemorrhage and scattered residual hematopoiesis. A definite central zone of amorphous acellular caseous necrosis is not appreciated at this magnification, and giant cells are not clearly resolved. Findings are consistent with granulomatous inflammation of the marrow; caseation should be confirmed at higher power, and AFB and fungal stains with cultures are recommended given the association with mycobacterial infection.

ddx.vs: Sarcoid-type granulomas are compact, epithelioid and lack central necrosis, whereas caseating granulomas have an acellular granular eosinophilic center.
Lipogranulomas are small, contain lipid vacuoles within histiocytes and lack a lymphocytic cuff or necrosis.
A polymorphous infiltrate with eosinophils, fibrosis and CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells distinguishes lymphoma-associated granulomas.
Morphology overlaps; GMS/PAS stains show yeasts, whereas mycobacteria require Ziehl-Neelsen or culture/PCR.

65768.recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶核型圖：一條 16 號染色體被箭頭標為 der(16)，帶型與另一條正常 16 號不同，符合 16 號染色體臂間倒位 inv(16)(p13q22)；其餘染色體數目為 46 條、性染色體 XY，這個細微的 16 號異常要仔細比對兩條同源染色體才看得出來。
features: G-banded karyogram with 46 chromosomes and XY sex chromosomes
One chromosome 16 marked der(16) with an altered banding pattern compared with its normal homolog
Banding change is consistent with pericentric inversion inv(16)(p13.1q22)
No other numerical or structural abnormality evident at this band resolution
Moderate band resolution; the Y chromosome appears faded/partially masked in the image
65768.describe_en: This is a G-banded karyogram rather than a morphologic image. It shows a male karyotype with 46 chromosomes in which one chromosome 16 (arrow, der(16)) has an abnormal banding pattern relative to its homolog, consistent with inv(16)(p13.1q22). No additional abnormalities are apparent at this resolution. Because inv(16) is subtle on banding, confirmation by CBFB break-apart FISH or RT-PCR for CBFB::MYH11 is recommended; here RT-PCR confirmed the fusion. Findings are consistent with 46,XY,inv(16)(p13.1q22), defining AML with CBFB::MYH11.

ddx.vs: The balanced translocation involves both chromosome 16 homologs and yields the same CBFB::MYH11 fusion, whereas here only one chromosome 16 is abnormal.
A 16q deletion shortens the long arm without restoring band length, whereas an inversion preserves overall length with rearranged bands; FISH resolves ambiguous cases.

65000.recognize_zh: 移植後嗜中性球低下病人的前臂與手背出現多發散在、中央黑色壞死結痂（eschar）且周圍紅暈的丘疹結節，這種播散性壞死性皮膚病灶是侵襲性鐮孢菌（Fusarium）感染的典型皮膚表現。
features: Clinical photograph of the forearm and dorsal hand with multiple scattered papulonodular lesions
Lesions have central black necrotic eschar with a surrounding erythematous to violaceous rim ('target-like')
Lesions of varying size and stage, some coalescent, distributed over the extremity including the fingers
Background diffuse skin darkening, dryness and desquamation; adhesive tape residue from lines
65000.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the upper extremity shows numerous disseminated erythematous papules and nodules, many with central black necrotic eschars and an erythematous halo, involving the forearm, dorsum of the hand and fingers. In a profoundly immunosuppressed HSCT recipient, multiple necrotic skin lesions appearing in crops are highly suggestive of disseminated angioinvasive mould infection; Fusarium is classically associated with such lesions and frequently positive blood cultures. Biopsy with culture and histology (septate hyaline hyphae with acute-angle branching) is required for confirmation. Findings are consistent with disseminated invasive fusariosis.

ddx.vs: Clinically similar necrotic eschars, but tissue Gram stain and culture show bacteria rather than septate hyaline hyphae.

ddx.dx: Invasive aspergillosis or mucormycosis of skin
ddx.vs: Histology may overlap; Fusarium tends to produce multiple disseminated lesions with positive blood cultures and adventitious sporulation, and culture is needed to separate them.
Leukemic infiltrates form violaceous nodules without central necrotic eschar and biopsy shows blasts instead of fungal elements.
Retiform purpura with necrosis follows vascular territories and biopsy shows vasculitis or microthrombi without organisms.

65576.recognize_zh: 血液與骨髓中的中型細胞核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少而深藍，看起來像淋巴芽細胞；但流式顯示 CD34 陰性、CD10 與 CD20 陽性且 kappa 限制，MYC 陽性、Ki-67 近 100%，表示是 blastoid 型雙打擊 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Medium-sized mononuclear cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin, and scant basophilic cytoplasm in blood (panels A-B)
Bone marrow aspirate dominated by monotonous blastoid cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm (panel C)
Biopsy with diffuse sheets of intermediate-sized cells replacing marrow (panel D)
IHC: diffuse nuclear PAX5 (E), cytoplasmic staining in panel F (BCL2 among the markers listed), nuclear MYC in many cells (G), and Ki-67 approaching 100% (H)
Flow cytometry: CD45-dim cells in the blast region, CD34 negative, cyCD79a positive, CD19 positive, CD3 negative, CD10 positive, and kappa restricted (panels I-M)
65576.describe_en: Peripheral blood shows occasional medium-sized cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin, and scant basophilic cytoplasm, and the bone marrow aspirate is largely replaced by similar blastoid cells. The biopsy shows diffuse sheets of intermediate-sized cells that are PAX5 positive with strong MYC expression and a Ki-67 index approaching 100%. Flow cytometry demonstrates a CD34-negative, CD19+, CD10+, cytoplasmic CD79a+ B-cell population with kappa light chain restriction. The presence of surface light chain restriction and absence of CD34/TdT argue against lymphoblastic leukemia; with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements by FISH, findings are consistent with DLBCL/HGBL with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, blastoid morphology.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts are usually CD34 and/or TdT positive and lack surface immunoglobulin light chain restriction, unlike this kappa-restricted TdT-negative population.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with lipid vacuoles, are BCL2 negative, and carry MYC rearrangement without BCL2 rearrangement.
Blastoid MCL is CD5 positive, CD10 negative, and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive, while this case is CD10+ and cyclin D1 negative.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML blasts lack PAX5, CD19, and light chain expression and typically express CD34/CD117/CD13/CD33.

65576.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: PAX5, BCL2, MYC, Ki-67; flow

65512.recognize_zh: 血片中大型異常細胞帶淡藍細胞質與細長針狀包涵體，看似 Auer rod；但 MPO 染色陰性，流式顯示 CD19/CD20+、κ 單株、CD5−/CD10− 的 B 細胞，骨髓切片 CD20 瀰漫陽性，指向 B 細胞淋巴瘤的假 Auer rod。
features: Panel A: large atypical cells with oval nuclei, open immature-appearing chromatin and abundant pale cytoplasm
Thin, dark, needle-like rod-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions mimicking Auer rods (inset)
Panel B: cytochemical MPO stain without brown-black reactivity in the atypical cell
Panel C: flow cytometry shows CD19+ CD20+ B cells with kappa light chain restriction, negative for CD5 and CD10
Panel D: marrow imprint with lymphoid cells, H&E trephine with diffuse sheets of small lymphocytes, and diffuse CD20 immunostaining
65512.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous large atypical mononuclear cells with oval nuclei, open chromatin and abundant pale cytoplasm containing thin, needle-like Auer rod-like inclusions. A cytochemical myeloperoxidase stain is negative in the atypical cells, arguing against true Auer rods. Flow cytometry demonstrates a kappa-restricted CD19+ CD20+ B-cell population lacking CD5 and CD10. The bone marrow trephine shows a diffuse lymphoid infiltrate that is strongly CD20 positive. Findings are consistent with relapsed B-cell (marginal zone) lymphoma with Auer rod-like (presumably immunoglobulin) inclusions, mimicking therapy-related acute myeloid leukemia.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with true Auer rods
ddx.vs: True Auer rods are fused primary granules that are MPO positive and occur in CD34/CD117-positive myeloblasts, whereas these inclusions are MPO negative in kappa-restricted mature B cells.
APL shows bundles of MPO-positive Auer rods in heavily granulated bilobed promyelocytes with CD34-/HLA-DR- myeloid phenotype, not CD20-positive lymphoid cells.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell neoplasm with crystalline inclusions
ddx.vs: Crystal-storing plasma cells are CD138-positive with cytoplasmic light chain and usually lack CD19/CD20, unlike this surface kappa-positive CD20-positive population.

65512.stain: Wright-Giemsa, MPO, flow, H&E, IHC: CD20

65384.recognize_zh: 這是以流式細胞圖為主的組合圖：A、B 為中型、高核質比、染色質細緻的母細胞；C–E 顯示 CD45 陰性、CD19+CD10+CD34+CD20+ 的 B 淋巴母細胞群；F 為 CRLF2 高表現，G 顯示未刺激狀態下 pSTAT5 已升高而 pSTAT3（H）不升高，與 T 細胞對照（K–N）比較，支持 CRLF2 重組 B-ALL 的 STAT5 持續活化。
features: Panels A–B: medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio, round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm
Panel C: CD45-negative/low, low side-scatter blast population separate from granulocytes, monocytes and lymphocytes
Panels D–E: blasts are uniformly CD19+CD10+ with CD34 and CD20 expression
Panel F: bright CRLF2 (TSLP-R) expression on leukemic blasts compared with residual normal lymphocytes
Panels G–J: unstimulated blasts show a right-shifted pSTAT5 peak but not pSTAT3, while stimulated pSTAT3/pSTAT5 responses remain inducible
Panels K–N: normal T cells show low basal pSTAT3/pSTAT5 with increases only after cytokine stimulation
65384.describe_en: Composite figure. Peripheral blood and bone marrow aspirate smears show medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin, and scant agranular cytoplasm. Flow cytometry identifies a CD45-negative, low side-scatter population expressing CD19, CD10, CD34 and CD20, consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia. Leukemic blasts show bright CRLF2 surface expression, and phospho-flow demonstrates increased basal pSTAT5 without basal pSTAT3 activation, in contrast to internal T-cell controls that phosphorylate STAT3 and STAT5 only after IL-6 or IL-2 stimulation. Findings are consistent with B-ALL with CRLF2 overexpression and constitutive JAK-STAT5 signaling, as seen with P2RY8::CRLF2 fusion (Ph-like B-ALL).

ddx.vs: Ph-positive B-ALL is identified by t(9;22) or BCR::ABL1 by FISH/RT-PCR, whereas CRLF2-rearranged Ph-like B-ALL lacks BCR::ABL1 and shows bright surface CRLF2.
Flow cannot separate CRLF2 fusion partners; FISH distinguishes P2RY8::CRLF2 (PAR1 deletion) from IGH::CRLF2 translocation.
Hematogones show a maturing continuum of CD34, CD10, CD20 and CD45 expression without aberrant uniform CRLF2 overexpression.

65320.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中正常造血幾乎被單一形態的中型細胞片狀取代，細胞核圓或卵圓、染色質細緻、可見小核仁，細胞質中等量且淡染到透亮，細胞界線清楚，需以 CD4、CD56、CD123 免疫染色確認為 BPDCN。
features: Hypercellular marrow with diffuse sheets of monomorphic medium-sized cells between fat spaces
Round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate to abundant pale to clear cytoplasm with distinct cell borders
Marked reduction of normal trilineage hematopoiesis, with few residual erythroid clusters
Scattered granulocytic cells and fine pigment deposits
65320.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow extensively replaced by diffuse sheets of monomorphic medium-sized cells with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli, and moderate pale to clear cytoplasm with distinct cell borders. Residual normal hematopoiesis is markedly reduced. No granulomas or fibrosis are apparent in this field. The morphology is that of a blastic infiltrate and, with the supportive CD4 and CD123 immunostains, is consistent with marrow involvement by blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Myeloid blasts are MPO, CD34, CD117 or lysozyme positive and lack co-expression of CD123, TCF4 and TCL1 with CD4 and CD56.
Hairy cells also show clear cytoplasm with 'fried-egg' spacing but are small mature B cells positive for CD20, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E.
Mast cell infiltrates are often paratrabecular with spindle cells and fibrosis and express tryptase and CD117.

65256.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片可見少數中至大型異常淋巴球，核輪廓不規則、染色質較細緻，部分有中等量淡藍色細胞質；流式細胞儀同時分出兩群：CD19+/CD20+ 無輕鏈表現的 B 細胞，以及表面 CD3 陰性、胞質 CD3+、CD4+、CD10+、CD279 (PD-1)+ 的 TFH 表型 T 細胞，提示循環中的複合型 B 與 T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Medium to large atypical lymphoid cells in peripheral blood with irregular, indented nuclear contours (A-D)
Moderately condensed to finely clumped chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous at this resolution in most cells
Moderate amount of pale to deeply basophilic cytoplasm, without granules
Flow: small CD19+/CD20 bright B-cell population lacking surface kappa and lambda light chains
Flow: aberrant T-cell population (orange) surface CD3-negative, cytoplasmic CD3+, CD2+, CD5+, CD4+, CD7 dim/negative, CD10+ and CD279+ (TFH phenotype)
65256.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a few medium- to large-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular nuclear contours, condensed chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm; morphology alone does not assign lineage. Flow cytometry identifies two abnormal populations: a minor CD19+ CD20-bright B-cell population without surface light chain expression, and a larger T-cell population that lacks surface CD3 but expresses cytoplasmic CD3, CD2, CD5, CD4, CD10 and CD279, with diminished CD7. Findings are suggestive of circulating composite lymphoma with a B-lymphoproliferative disorder and a T-follicular helper cell lymphoma; tissue biopsy is required for classification.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells are CD4+ with loss of CD7/CD26 and cerebriform nuclei but lack CD10 and PD-1 coexpression with surface CD3 loss, and there is no separate abnormal B-cell population.
Reactive lymphocytes are polyclonal with normal T-cell antigen expression and polytypic B cells, lacking surface CD3 loss or light chain-negative B cells.
ATLL shows flower-shaped nuclei and CD4+/CD25+ T cells with CD7 loss but is CD10- and HTLV-1-positive.
A pure B-cell process would not explain the phenotypically aberrant CD10+/PD-1+ T-cell population.

65192.recognize_zh: 同一切片分成兩區：左側為染色質細緻、類母細胞的 blastoid 細胞，右側為核大、具明顯核仁的多形性細胞；兩區皆 cyclin D1 陽性，但只有多形性區 CD10 與 cMyc 陽性，FISH 在多形性區可見大量分離的 MYC（紅）與 BCL2（綠）訊號及 BCL6 分離訊號，PET 顯示 ibrutinib 治療後病灶進展。
features: Biopsy with two juxtaposed populations separated by a sharp interface at low power (A)
Blastoid cells: medium-sized, high N:C ratio, fine dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli (B1)
Pleomorphic cells: larger, irregular vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli and more cytoplasm (B2)
Cyclin D1 positive in both areas; CD10 and cMyc positive only in the pleomorphic area (C-E)
FISH: fused/normal signals in blastoid area vs numerous isolated red MYC and green BCL2 signals (amplified rearrangements) and BCL6 split signals in the pleomorphic area (F-H)
PET MIP images showing new/progressive FDG-avid lesions after ibrutinib (I, J)
65192.describe_en: The biopsy shows two distinct, sharply demarcated lymphoma populations. One area consists of medium-sized blastoid cells with fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm, and the adjacent area consists of larger pleomorphic cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli. Both components are cyclin D1-positive, whereas only the pleomorphic component expresses CD10 and cMyc. FISH shows no MYC, BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement in the blastoid area but amplified rearranged MYC and BCL2 signals with BCL6 rearrangement in the pleomorphic area. Findings are consistent with blastoid mantle cell lymphoma with a clonally evolved pleomorphic component carrying triple-hit genetic alterations, with radiologic progression on BTK inhibitor therapy.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements (de novo)
ddx.vs: De novo double/triple-hit lymphoma is cyclin D1- and SOX11-negative, whereas both components here retain cyclin D1 positivity indicating MCL lineage.
CD5+ DLBCL lacks cyclin D1 overexpression and CCND1 rearrangement.
Blastoid MCL may mimic lymphoblasts, but LBL is TdT+ and cyclin D1-negative.

ddx.dx: Pleomorphic mantle cell lymphoma without transformation
ddx.vs: Ordinary pleomorphic MCL is typically CD10-negative and lacks MYC/BCL2 rearrangements, which here define the evolved clone.

65192.stain: H&E; IHC: cyclin D1, CD10, cMyc; FISH; PET

64936.recognize_zh: 兩支倒置的紫蓋 EDTA 採血管：左側病人檢體呈膠凍狀，血液黏附在管底上方（箭頭）不往下流，蓋端可見凝塊碎片；右側正常對照血液則自然流到蓋端、上方僅留薄層。在淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤病人，應考慮冷凝球蛋白在室溫下沉澱造成的假性凝固。
features: Two inverted lavender-top (K2-EDTA) vacutainers photographed side by side
Patient tube (left): blood remains stuck at the closed end despite inversion, forming a dark gel-like column (arrow)
Patient tube: red, clot-like fragments accumulated near the cap
Control tube (right): freely flowing blood settled toward the cap with a clean upper wall
Gross observation only; no microscopic or quantitative data in the figure
64936.describe_en: Gross photograph of two inverted EDTA vacutainers. The patient sample (left) fails to flow on inversion, with a dark gel-like column adherent to the closed end of the tube and clot-like fragments near the cap, whereas the normal control sample (right) flows freely toward the cap. Because the anticoagulated sample gelled immediately and could not be mixed, the appearance suggests cold-induced precipitation of a cryoglobulin rather than true clotting. In a patient with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma, findings are consistent with cryoglobulinemia; samples should be collected and transported at 37 degrees Celsius and cryoglobulins confirmed in serum kept warm until separation.

ddx.dx: Pre-analytic clotting from inadequate mixing or difficult venipuncture
ddx.vs: True clots form fibrin strands that do not redissolve on warming and occur without cryoprotein, whereas cryoglobulin gelling reverses at 37 degrees Celsius.
Cold agglutinins cause visible red cell granular agglutination on the tube wall that disperses on warming, but the plasma remains fluid rather than gelling.

ddx.dx: Hyperviscosity from IgM paraprotein without cryoprecipitation
ddx.vs: Hyperviscous samples flow slowly but do flow and are not temperature-dependent.

65128.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中可見多個偏心核、細胞質豐富的漿細胞，其中數顆細胞質染成桃紅洋紅色、邊緣呈火焰狀（flame cells），並夾雜體積不一的漿細胞，提示漿細胞腫瘤。
features: Increased plasma cells of variable size, including large forms with abundant cytoplasm
Eccentric round nuclei with clumped chromatin and occasional perinuclear hof
Several cells with intensely magenta-pink cytoplasm and frayed peripheral margins (flame cells)
Some large cells with pale grey-lilac cytoplasm and a peripheral pink rim
Background small mature lymphocytes and erythroid precursors; poorly spread, yellow-tinged red cells
65128.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous plasma cells of varying size admixed with small lymphocytes and erythroid precursors. Many plasma cells are large with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin and abundant cytoplasm; several have intensely magenta, glycoprotein-rich cytoplasm with irregular, frayed margins characteristic of flame cells. No overt immature plasmablastic forms with prominent nucleoli are evident in this field. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm with flame cell morphology; correlation with flow cytometry (light-chain restriction) and clinical workup is required.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are usually small, mature and polytypic, whereas this field shows sheets of large, pleomorphic flame cells and flow shows kappa restriction.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P, rather than a dominant population of large pleomorphic plasma cells.
Macrophages have larger reniform nuclei with fine chromatin and vacuolated or phagocytic cytoplasm, not eccentric clock-face nuclei with magenta cytoplasmic fringes.

64872.recognize_zh: 這是多格組合圖：低倍 H&E 可見小而分散、生發中心退化的濾泡與血管豐富的濾泡間區，CD138 顯示濾泡間大量漿細胞，TdT/CD99 標出散在的小型不成熟 T 細胞，流式則見 CD34+/CD10+/cyTdT+/cyCD3+ 的小族群，符合特發性多中心 Castleman 病合併少量不成熟 T 細胞增生。
features: Low power: lymph node with small, widely spaced follicles showing regressed germinal centers
Interfollicular expansion with prominent vascularity on H&E
CD138 IHC: sheets and clusters of interfollicular plasma cells sparing follicles
TdT and CD99 IHC: numerous small, scattered positive cells in interfollicular areas without cytologic atypia
Flow cytometry: discrete CD45-dim population expressing CD34, CD10, cytoplasmic TdT and cytoplasmic CD3 (immature T cells)
64872.describe_en: Composite figure of an excised lymph node. H&E sections show preserved architecture with small, widely spaced follicles with regressed germinal centers and a hypervascular interfollicular zone. CD138 highlights a marked interfollicular plasmacytosis, while TdT and CD99 stain frequent small, cytologically bland interfollicular cells. Flow cytometry plots demonstrate a discrete CD45-dim population co-expressing CD34, CD10, cytoplasmic CD3, and TdT, consistent with immature T cells; per the submitters, TCR gene rearrangement was polyclonal and LANA was negative. Findings are consistent with HHV-8-negative idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease with a modest proliferation of immature T cells, which should not be over-interpreted as T-lymphoblastic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: T-LBL effaces the node with sheets of atypical blasts and shows clonal TCR rearrangement, whereas here TdT+ cells are scattered, bland, and polyclonal with preserved Castleman-type architecture.
This is the closest descriptive entity for bland TdT+ T cells without clonality and may accompany Castleman disease; distinction from the host lesion relies on distribution and molecular studies.
HHV-8 MCD shows LANA-positive plasmablasts in the mantle zones, which were absent here.
These may show plasmacytosis but lack regressed, vessel-penetrated follicles and require IgG4/IgG ratio and serologic correlation.

64872.stain: H&E; IHC: CD138, TdT, CD99; flow cytometry

64744.recognize_zh: 一個巨大的原紅血球，深藍細胞質邊緣呈扇貝狀並帶小空泡，核巨大、核內為淡紫色細顆粒毛玻璃樣包涵體，染色質集中於核膜並有一兩處深色塊，與旁邊的嗜酸性球及嗜中性球相比極為巨大，符合 Parvovirus B19 燈籠細胞。
features: Giant pronormoblast many times larger than adjacent eosinophil and neutrophils (scale bar 10 µm)
Intensely basophilic cytoplasm with scalloped/blebbed outer border and fine vacuoles
Large round nucleus with pale lilac, finely granular glassy inclusion and chromatin condensed along the nuclear membrane
Paler perinuclear cytoplasmic halo
Nearby disrupted eosinophil with scattered granules, band neutrophils and a myelocyte
64744.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant pronormoblast with deeply basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm with scalloped margins and a very large nucleus containing a pale, glassy, finely granular intranuclear inclusion with peripheral chromatin margination. Adjacent granulocytes, including a partially disrupted eosinophil and neutrophils, provide a size reference. The appearance is that of a lantern cell and is consistent with parvovirus B19 infection; viral confirmation by PCR or serology is recommended.

ddx.vs: PEL shows sheets of proerythroblast-like blasts without glassy intranuclear inclusions, whereas parvovirus shows few scattered giant infected pronormoblasts in an erythroid-hypoplastic marrow.
Megaloblastic erythroid precursors show nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony across all stages with open chromatin, not isolated giant cells with viral inclusions.

ddx.dx: Metastatic tumor cell (e.g., neuroblastoma or rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: Tumor cells typically occur in cohesive clusters with nucleoli and lack the glassy intranuclear inclusion and erythroid phenotype.

64616.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片右側大片區域失去造血細胞，呈淡粉紅的水腫/壞死基質，其中可見許多淡藍紫色細長絲狀結構（菌絲輪廓），夾雜紅血球外滲與棕色含鐵血黃素，左側殘存造血組織與脂肪。
features: Large paucicellular zone of pale eosinophilic edematous/necrotic stroma replacing hematopoietic tissue
Numerous faint pale basophilic slender filamentous structures (probable fungal hyphae) within the paucicellular area
Extravasated red cells and scattered brown hemosiderin-laden macrophages
Residual hematopoietic cells and fat spaces at the left; bony trabeculae at upper right
No granulomas or well-formed abscess evident in this field
64616.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a large area in which hematopoietic elements are replaced by pale, eosinophilic, edematous to necrotic stroma containing extravasated red cells, scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages and numerous faint, slender, basophilic filamentous structures suggestive of fungal hyphae. Residual cellular hematopoietic marrow with fat is present at the periphery, and bony trabeculae are seen. Well-formed granulomas are not identified. Findings are suggestive of invasive fungal infection of the marrow with associated stromal injury, to be confirmed with GMS/PAS stains and culture.

ddx.vs: Gelatinous transformation shows pale amorphous extracellular matrix around atrophic fat without filamentous organisms, hemorrhage or necrosis.

ddx.dx: Bone marrow necrosis (non-infectious, e.g., sickle cell or tumor)
ddx.vs: Ischemic necrosis shows ghost cells and granular eosinophilic debris without intervening hyphal structures, which GMS would exclude.

ddx.dx: Post-chemotherapy marrow aplasia with stromal edema
ddx.vs: Post-therapy aplasia shows dilated sinusoids, edema and fat but lacks filamentous organisms; special stains are negative.
Fibrotic marrow shows streaming collagen/reticulin with atypical megakaryocytes rather than loose edematous stroma with hyphae and hemorrhage.

64680.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中造血組織幾乎被成片的大型組織球取代，細胞質豐富、淡粉紅並呈細纖維狀「皺紋紙」（crumpled tissue paper）質地，核小而偏位，符合 Gaucher 病骨髓浸潤。
features: Diffuse sheets of large histiocytes (Gaucher cells) replacing normal marrow hematopoiesis
Abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with fine fibrillary/striated 'wrinkled tissue paper' texture
Small, round to oval, eccentric bland nuclei without significant atypia
Scattered residual clusters of hematopoietic cells and red cells between histiocytes
Bony trabecula at the top; marrow fat markedly reduced
64680.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows diffuse replacement of the marrow space by sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic, finely fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm and small bland eccentric nuclei. Residual hematopoietic elements are reduced and present only as small scattered clusters, and marrow fat is sparse. No atypical lymphoid or plasma cell infiltrate is apparent. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by Gaucher disease; confirmation by glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay and GBA1 genotyping is recommended.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, MDS, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells are scattered within an underlying neoplastic or infectious marrow process, whereas here sheets of Gaucher-like cells dominate without a background neoplasm; enzyme assay separates them.
Niemann-Pick cells have finely vacuolated, bubbly 'foamy' cytoplasm rather than striated fibrillary tissue-paper cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterial infection (e.g., MAI) with histiocytic infiltrate
ddx.vs: Mycobacteria-laden histiocytes may appear striated but are usually accompanied by granulomatous inflammation and are positive on AFB stain.
Crystal-storing histiocytes contain eosinophilic crystalline inclusions of immunoglobulin light chain associated with a lymphoplasmacytic neoplasm, confirmed by kappa/lambda IHC.

64360.recognize_zh: 一顆比周圍骨髓細胞大上數倍的巨核細胞，核為多葉相連、細胞質布滿細小顆粒，左下緣的細胞質正碎裂出成群的血小板，符合正在產生血小板的成熟巨核細胞。
features: Very large cell with abundant pink-purple finely granular cytoplasm
Multilobated, overlapping connected nuclear lobes with condensed chromatin
Cytoplasmic margin fragmenting into clusters of released platelets (lower left)
No separated nuclear lobes, hypolobation, or micromegakaryocytic features
Background maturing granulocytes and lymphocytes; stain has a warm pink cast
64360.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large mature megakaryocyte with a multilobated nucleus and abundant finely granular cytoplasm. Along one margin, the cytoplasm is fragmenting into clusters of platelets, indicating active thrombopoiesis. Background myeloid and lymphoid cells show no significant abnormality. No dysplastic features are seen in this cell. Findings are consistent with a normal platelet-producing megakaryocyte.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts contain multiple separate uniform round nuclei with nucleoli and coarsely granular cytoplasm, without platelet budding.
Dysplastic forms show small hypolobated nuclei, widely separated nuclear lobes, or micromegakaryocytes, which are not present here.
ET megakaryocytes are enlarged with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei and loose clusters, which require biopsy assessment beyond a single normal-appearing cell.

64424.recognize_zh: 同一淋巴結中兩種腫瘤緊鄰：左側為大型、多形性、核不規則的片狀細胞（CD30 強陽性、ALK 陰性），右側為界線清楚的單一小至中型淋巴細胞結節（CD20 與 cyclin D1 陽性），即 ALK 陰性 ALCL 合併被套細胞淋巴瘤的複合型淋巴瘤。
features: Two sharply demarcated neoplastic compartments within one lymph node (panel A)
ALCL component: sheets of large pleomorphic cells with irregular, kidney-shaped or multilobated nuclei, prominent nucleoli and ample eosinophilic cytoplasm (panel B left)
MCL component: monotonous small to medium lymphocytes with slightly irregular nuclei, dispersed chromatin and scant cytoplasm (panel B right)
CD30 strong membranous and Golgi staining in the large cells, ALK-negative (panels C, E with inset)
CD20 and nuclear cyclin D1 restricted to the nodular small-cell component (panels D, F)
64424.describe_en: Excisional lymph node biopsy shows two distinct, juxtaposed lymphoid neoplasms. One component consists of sheets of large pleomorphic cells with irregular, horseshoe-like to multilobated nuclei, prominent nucleoli and abundant cytoplasm; these cells are strongly and uniformly CD30-positive and ALK-negative. The adjacent nodular component is composed of monotonous small to medium-sized lymphocytes with slightly irregular nuclei that are CD20-positive and show nuclear cyclin D1 expression. Findings are consistent with a composite lymphoma: ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma and mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: cHL shows scattered CD30+/CD15+/PAX5-weak Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in an inflammatory background rather than cohesive sheets of CD30+ T cells.

ddx.dx: Pleomorphic variant of mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Pleomorphic MCL large cells would express CD20 and cyclin D1, whereas the large cells here are CD20- and cyclin D1-negative with strong CD30.
ALK-positive ALCL shows nuclear/cytoplasmic ALK staining and typically occurs in younger patients; ALK is negative here (panel E inset).
Carcinoma forms cohesive nests and is cytokeratin/GATA3-positive, while the large cells here are discohesive, CD30+ and express T-cell antigens.

64424.stain: H&E; IHC: CD30, CD20, cyclin D1, ALK

64040.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆巨核細胞胞質豐富、帶細顆粒，但只有一個圓形不分葉的核（monolobated megakaryocyte），周圍為各階段顆粒球與紅血球前驅細胞，符合 MDS del(5q) 的巨核細胞形態。
features: Central megakaryocyte of medium size with abundant finely granular basophilic-to-pink cytoplasm
Single round, eccentric, non-lobated nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin
Adjacent small cells overlapping the megakaryocyte border
Background granulocytic precursors (promyelocytes, myelocytes, bands) and basophilic erythroblasts
No increase in blasts evident in this field
64040.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Romanowsky stain, high power) shows a megakaryocyte with abundant finely granular cytoplasm and a single round non-lobated nucleus. The surrounding marrow contains maturing granulocytic precursors including promyelocytes, myelocytes and band forms, together with erythroid precursors. Blasts are not increased in this field. The monolobated megakaryocyte morphology is characteristic of myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q), which must be confirmed by karyotype or FISH.

ddx.vs: Immature megakaryocytic cells are smaller with scant deeply basophilic, often blebbed cytoplasm and fine chromatin, unlike this granular cell with a condensed single nucleus.
Micromegakaryocytes are much smaller (near promyelocyte size), whereas del(5q) megakaryocytes are normal to medium size with a round nucleus.
Plasma cells are smaller with a perinuclear hof and basophilic non-granular cytoplasm, and osteoblasts have a hof separated from the nucleus and occur in clusters.
Normal or reactive megakaryocytes of this size show multilobated nuclei.

63912.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中顆粒周圍有大量中型、細胞質淡灰藍無顆粒、核染色質細緻的母細胞（箭頭），在紅血球前驅細胞與小淋巴球之間明顯增多，是 BPDCN 骨髓侵犯的低倍樣貌。
features: Cellular aspirate particle with increased medium-sized blasts (arrow)
Blasts with round to indented nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm
Scattered admixed erythroid precursors, small lymphocytes and occasional granulocytes
Several cells with more deeply basophilic cytoplasm; fat spaces present
63912.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows a cellular particle with an increased population of medium-sized blasts (arrow) that have round to indented nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm. Residual trilineage hematopoiesis, including erythroid precursors and maturing granulocytes, and small lymphocytes are admixed. Fine cytologic detail such as vacuoles is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a blastic neoplasm, compatible with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm with immunophenotypic confirmation.

ddx.vs: AML blasts often show granules or Auer rods and express MPO/CD34/CD117, whereas BPDCN blasts are agranular and CD123/TCL1/CD4/CD56-positive.
Lymphoblasts are TdT-positive with B or T lineage markers and have scantier cytoplasm.
Hematogones are small cells with homogeneous chromatin and scant cytoplasm showing a maturation spectrum on flow cytometry, not large blasts with gray-blue cytoplasm.

63848.recognize_zh: 這張鹼性電泳片上，箭頭所指的第一條泳道只有一條落在 S/D/G 位置的粗帶、看不到 HbA 帶，而其他泳道多為 A 帶或 A 加 S/D 兩帶；只有 S/D 區帶且無 HbA，在這個家族研究中對應到 HbS 與 HbD 雙重異合子（HbSD），因為 S 與 D 在鹼性 pH 下同位置。
features: Alkaline cellulose acetate hemoglobin electrophoresis with eight sample lanes (unlabeled)
Arrowed top lane: single dense slow-moving band in the S/D/G region without an HbA band
Several lanes with two bands (S/D/G region plus HbA) indicating heterozygous carriers
Lanes with a dominant HbA band only, and faint minor bands near the origin (A2/C region)
Two lanes with a single band of intermediate mobility whose identity is not labeled
63848.describe_en: Hemoglobin electrophoresis at alkaline pH shows, in the arrowed lane, a single prominent slow-moving band in the S/D/G region with no detectable HbA band. Other lanes demonstrate either a two-band pattern with HbA plus an S/D/G-region band, consistent with heterozygous carriers, or a predominant HbA band. Because HbS, HbD and HbG co-migrate at alkaline pH, the index pattern cannot distinguish SS, SD or DD; acid electrophoresis, a sickling test and HPLC are required. In this family study, the pattern supports compound heterozygous HbSD disease confirmed by twin S- and D-window peaks on HPLC. The unlabeled lanes with intermediate mobility cannot be interpreted from the image alone.

ddx.vs: HbSS gives the same single S/D band at alkaline pH but shows one band with HbS mobility on acid agar and a single S-window HPLC peak, whereas in HbSD the D component runs with HbA on acid agar.
HbDD gives the same alkaline band but is sickling-test negative and clinically mild, with a single D-window HPLC peak.
S/beta0-thalassemia also lacks HbA but shows increased HbA2 and microcytosis, without a D-window variant on HPLC.

63784.recognize_zh: 整片抹片背景呈灰藍色，紅血球排成像疊錢幣般的長鏈與分枝（rouleaux），提示血中有大量單株免疫球蛋白，符合多發性骨髓瘤。
features: Diffuse bluish-gray background staining of the smear
Prominent rouleaux: red cells stacked in linear and branching chains
A mature segmented neutrophil with unremarkable morphology
Scattered normal-appearing platelets
No circulating plasma cells in this field
63784.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a diffusely bluish background with prominent rouleaux formation, with red cells aligned in linear and branching stacks throughout the field. A single mature neutrophil and scattered platelets are unremarkable. No circulating plasma cells are identified in this field. These findings indicate increased plasma protein, typically a monoclonal paraprotein, and are suggestive of a plasma cell neoplasm such as plasma cell myeloma; correlation with serum protein electrophoresis and immunofixation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Agglutinates form irregular three-dimensional clumps rather than linear coin-like stacks and disperse on warming, while rouleaux disperse with saline.
Overlapping cells occur only in the thick part of the smear and lack the blue background, whereas true rouleaux persist in the monolayer.

ddx.dx: Polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia or high fibrinogen (inflammation, liver disease)
ddx.vs: Can also cause rouleaux; distinction requires SPEP/immunofixation showing polyclonal rather than monoclonal protein.
Also produces rouleaux and blue background from IgM paraprotein; lymphoplasmacytic cells and IgM with MYD88 L265P mutation separate it.

63720.recognize_zh: 視野中幾乎每一顆分葉嗜中性球的邊緣都黏附一圈小而深紫紅的血小板，像衛星一樣環繞（platelet satellitism），背景游離血小板相對稀少；這是 EDTA 引起的體外現象，會造成假性血小板低下。
features: Multiple segmented neutrophils each rimmed by adherent platelets (rosettes)
Platelets are small, granular, magenta and closely applied to the neutrophil membrane
Neutrophil nuclear segmentation and cytoplasm otherwise normal
Relatively few free platelets in the background
Red cells with some crenated forms and overlapping in thicker area
63720.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous segmented neutrophils, each surrounded by a rim of adherent platelets forming rosettes (platelet satellitism). The neutrophils are otherwise morphologically unremarkable, and free platelets in the background are relatively sparse. Red cells show some crenation, likely artifactual. Findings are consistent with EDTA-dependent platelet satellitism, an in vitro phenomenon that can cause spurious thrombocytopenia (pseudothrombocytopenia); a repeat count on citrate- or heparin-anticoagulated blood is recommended.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumping forms free platelet aggregates, often at the feathered edge, rather than rosettes around neutrophils.
Phagocytosed platelets lie within the neutrophil cytoplasm or vacuoles rather than adhering to the outer membrane.
True thrombocytopenia shows few platelets throughout the smear without platelets sequestered around leukocytes, and the count is low on citrate samples too.
Toxic granules are intracytoplasmic within the neutrophil, whereas satellite platelets are separate bodies outside the cell border.

63656.recognize_zh: 左圖箭頭處巨噬細胞核偏心，淡藍色細胞質充滿纖維狀、帶條紋的紋理，形似揉皺的紙（crumpled tissue paper）；右圖箭頭處也有同樣淡藍灰、帶絲狀條紋的細胞質，為高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cell）。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Fibrillar, striated, wrinkled 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasmic texture
Small, round to oval, eccentric nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin
Cytoplasm not vacuolated or foamy; no ingested cells
Right panel: Gaucher cell cytoplasm partly smeared among granulocytic and erythroid precursors (two-panel composite)
63656.describe_en: Two-panel bone marrow aspirate composite (May-Grünwald-Giemsa). Among normal-appearing hematopoietic precursors are large histiocytes with small eccentric nuclei and abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm displaying a fibrillar, striated 'crumpled tissue paper' texture (arrows); in the right panel the cytoplasm is partly smeared. The cytoplasm is not vacuolated or foamy. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells; confirmation by glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay and GBA1 genotyping is recommended.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells in CML, myeloma, or thalassemia are morphologically near-identical and are separated by clinical context, normal enzyme activity, and the underlying neoplasm.
Foam cells have cytoplasm filled with uniform small lipid vacuoles (soap-bubble) rather than striated fibrils.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules instead of a fibrillar texture.
MAC-laden macrophages show negative-image rod striations and are acid-fast positive.

63464.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆大型巨核細胞，細胞核分葉而大，豐富的粉紫色顆粒狀細胞質內包著一顆完整、分葉的嗜中性球核（三至四個小葉），被包入的細胞形態保存完好，這就是巨核細胞的穿入現象（emperipolesis）。
features: Large megakaryocyte with a single large lobulated nucleus
Abundant pink-lavender finely granular cytoplasm
Intact segmented neutrophil (three to four lobes) located within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm
Engulfed cell shows preserved nuclear detail without degeneration
Adjacent band neutrophil, myelocyte-type cells, and a small lymphocyte/erythroid nucleus in the background
63464.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with a lobulated nucleus and abundant granular cytoplasm. Within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm lies an intact segmented neutrophil with well-preserved nuclear lobes and no evidence of degradation. Surrounding granulocytic precursors appear unremarkable. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic emperipolesis, a non-specific phenomenon that can be seen in reactive marrows (such as in this patient with autoimmune hemolytic anemia) and is increased in myeloproliferative neoplasms, particularly primary myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: In phagocytosis the host is a histiocyte with a smaller oval nucleus and vacuolated cytoplasm, and the ingested cell is degraded within a phagosome, whereas emperipolesis involves an intact cell in a megakaryocyte.

ddx.dx: Multilobated megakaryocyte nucleus in a hyperlobated/dysplastic megakaryocyte
ddx.vs: Separate nuclear lobes of the megakaryocyte are connected and share its chromatin, whereas the engulfed neutrophil has its own distinct dense lobes and thin rim of cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Overlying cell artifact on the smear
ddx.vs: A cell lying on top of the megakaryocyte shows a different focal plane and its cytoplasm extends beyond, whereas an emperipolesed cell sits within a clear halo inside the cytoplasm.

63400.recognize_zh: 雖然標題寫骨髓切片，但這張其實是骨髓抽吸抹片：中央淡藍色組織球（histiocyte）細胞質內外聚集大量 2–4 µm 的小圓形酵母樣體，周圍有透明暈，外觀像組織漿菌（Histoplasma）；圖中看不到上皮樣肉芽腫。
features: Histiocytes with pale blue cytoplasm packed with numerous small (approximately 2-4 um) round-to-oval yeast-like bodies
Organisms show a clear halo with a small eccentric dark crescent, and also lie free near the macrophages
Mixed marrow cells including lymphocytes, plasma cells and myeloid precursors
Bubbly/vacuolated smeared background with scattered degenerating cells
No cohesive epithelioid granuloma recognizable on this aspirate smear
63400.describe_en: The image is a bone marrow aspirate smear rather than a biopsy section. It shows histiocytes whose pale blue cytoplasm contains numerous small, uniform, round-to-oval yeast-like organisms with clear halos, with additional organisms free in the background. Surrounding cells include lymphocytes, plasma cells and myeloid precursors in a vacuolated background, and a cohesive epithelioid granuloma as described in the title is not appreciable. Findings are suggestive of disseminated fungal infection, most likely histoplasmosis; GMS/PAS stains, culture, antigen testing and correlation with the biopsy are recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have a nucleus plus a separate rod-shaped kinetoplast and are GMS-negative, whereas Histoplasma yeasts lack a kinetoplast and are GMS-positive.
T. marneffei yeasts are slightly larger, elongated and divide by a central transverse septum rather than budding.
Cryptococcus is larger (4-10 um) and more variable in size with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule and narrow-based budding.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped without halos and are identified by immunostaining rather than fungal stains.

63336.recognize_zh: 右半邊是明顯加粗、形狀不規則且互相連接的骨小樑（osteosclerosis），左半邊造血組織被纖維化取代、細胞呈流線狀排列（streaming）並有出血；在 PV 病史下是 post-PV myelofibrosis 的晚期骨髓表現。
features: Markedly thickened, irregular, anastomosing bony trabeculae with lamellar and appositional new bone (osteosclerosis)
Intertrabecular spaces filled by fibrotic stroma rather than fat or hematopoiesis
Left field: hypocellular fibrotic marrow with streaming of spindle cells and hyperchromatic nuclear fragments
Scattered dark, distorted megakaryocytic nuclei within the fibrosis
Focal hemorrhage; paucity of normal trilineage hematopoiesis
63336.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows markedly thickened, irregular and anastomosing bony trabeculae with new bone formation, consistent with osteosclerosis. The intertrabecular spaces are occupied by fibrotic stroma with streaming of spindle cells and distorted hyperchromatic hematopoietic nuclei, focal hemorrhage and loss of normal hematopoiesis. Reticulin and trichrome stains would be required to grade fibrosis. In a patient with polycythemia vera, findings are consistent with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis with osteosclerosis (MF-3 pattern).

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; separation depends on documented prior PV history per WHO/IWG-MRT criteria.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma with desmoplastic reaction and reactive new bone
ddx.vs: Metastatic carcinoma shows cohesive epithelial clusters that are keratin-positive within the fibrosis.
Osteitis fibrosa shows paratrabecular fibrosis with prominent osteoclastic resorption and osteoblast rimming without atypical megakaryocytes.
Mastocytosis shows paratrabecular spindle mast cell aggregates that are tryptase/CD117/CD25-positive.

63272.recognize_zh: CD117/CD33 流式散佈圖以四象限分區，紅色芽細胞族群落在右上象限（CD33+CD117+），棕色成熟嗜中性球與單核球只有 CD33+，紫色 T 細胞兩者皆陰性；芽細胞同時表現 CD33 與 CD117，表示其為骨髓系來源，符合 TAM。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot: CD117-APC (x-axis) versus CD33-PC5.5 (y-axis) with quadrant gates
Red blast population in the upper-right quadrant: CD33-positive and CD117-positive
Brown population (mature neutrophils/monocytes): CD33-positive, CD117-negative (upper-left quadrant)
Purple population (normal T cells): CD33-negative and CD117-negative/low
Black events (debris/other) with double-negative staining near the origin
63272.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of CD117 versus CD33 shows a large blast population (red) co-expressing CD33 and CD117, indicating myeloid derivation. Mature neutrophils and monocytes (brown) express CD33 without CD117, and normal T cells (purple) are negative for both markers, serving as internal controls. In a neonate with Down syndrome, myeloid blasts with this phenotype (typically also CD34+, CD7+, CD41/CD61+) are consistent with transient abnormal myelopoiesis; GATA1 mutation analysis supports the diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome
ddx.vs: Blast immunophenotype is essentially identical (CD33+CD117+, megakaryocytic markers); separation relies on age (usually after 1 month to 5 years), persistence, cytopenias and additional mutations beyond GATA1.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia in non-Down syndrome infants
ddx.vs: Blasts can share CD33/CD117 and CD41/CD61 expression, but patients lack trisomy 21/GATA1 mutation and often carry RBM15-MKL1 or CBFA2T3-GLIS2.
Requires cytoplasmic CD3 on the blasts in addition to myeloid markers, whereas CD7 aberrancy in TAM is not sufficient for T lineage.

63208.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片三格裡，大片淡紫色、蓬鬆雲霧狀的無定形物質佔滿視野中央，邊緣散布淋巴球、嗜中性球與少數漿細胞；低倍（下格）可見多團同樣物質連成一片，形態上提示類澱粉（amyloid）。
features: Broad sheets of extracellular amorphous, fluffy, cloud-like pale purple material
Deposits are acellular with smudgy, finely granular texture and indistinct feathery margins
Low-power strip (bottom) shows multiple confluent deposits across the smear
Admixed lymphocytes, granulocytes and occasional plasma cells at the edges of the deposits
Gray-staining red cell masses in thick areas of the smear
63208.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears (three fields, two at high power and one at low power) show broad extracellular sheets of amorphous, fluffy, cloud-like pale purple material with granular texture and indistinct borders. Lymphocytes, granulocytes and occasional plasma cells are distributed along the margins of the deposits, and the low-power field shows multiple confluent deposits across the smear. These features are suggestive of amyloid on a Romanowsky-stained smear, but the appearance is not specific and Congo red confirmation with polarization is required. Findings are suggestive of bone marrow involvement by amyloidosis.

ddx.dx: Fibrin clot in a partially clotted aspirate
ddx.vs: Fibrin forms fibrillar meshworks that trap platelets and cells and is Congo red negative.
Appears as pale pink-purple mucoid background material in a hypocellular smear and is Alcian blue positive but Congo red negative.
A crushed particle contains smeared nuclei, chromatin strands and fat spaces rather than acellular homogeneous fluffy deposits.

63144.recognize_zh: 一顆比紅血球稍大的淋巴球，核佔滿細胞且表面有多條深溝與摺痕，呈腦回狀（cerebriform），染色質濃縮深染、細胞質極少，是 Sezary 細胞的典型外觀。
features: Lymphoid cell slightly larger than adjacent red cells
Very high N:C ratio with only a thin rim of scant cytoplasm
Nucleus with multiple deep grooves and folds producing a cerebriform (convoluted) contour
Dense, hyperchromatic condensed chromatin; no visible nucleoli
No cytoplasmic granules or vacuoles
63144.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small to medium-sized atypical lymphocyte with a very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and scant cytoplasm. The nucleus is hyperchromatic with condensed chromatin and multiple deep linear grooves, producing a characteristic cerebriform appearance; nucleoli are not seen. Findings are consistent with a Sezary cell; in the appropriate clinical setting of erythroderma, confirmation of a clonal CD4-positive T-cell population with loss of CD7 and/or CD26 by flow cytometry is required for Sezary syndrome.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant basophilic cytoplasm and only occasional shallow indentations, and flow cytometry shows no aberrant T-cell phenotype.
ATLL cells have polylobated flower-like nuclei with deep lobation rather than fine grooves, with HTLV-1 serology positive and frequent CD25 expression.
T-PLL cells have a visible nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs with TCL1A rearrangement, whereas Sezary cells lack nucleoli.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma or CLL with cleaved nuclei
ddx.vs: These are B cells expressing CD19/CD20 (with CD5 and cyclin D1 in MCL), whereas Sezary cells are CD4-positive T cells.

63080.recognize_zh: 這不是顯微鏡影像，而是手繪示意圖「Figure 1A」：血管內皮、白血球、紅血球、血小板皆為未活化狀態、自由流動且無黏附，代表正常血流環境；可與 Figure 1B 的活化血栓發炎狀態對照。注意此圖為 1A，與標題「1b」不符。
features: Hand-drawn schematic of a blood vessel lumen labeled FIGURE 1A
Unactivated endothelial cells lining both walls
Free-flowing unactivated leukocytes, red cells and platelets without adhesion or aggregates
No NETs, microparticles, thrombin or cytokines depicted
Legend defines each cell symbol
63080.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic, hand-drawn schematic (labeled Figure 1A) rather than a microscopic image. It depicts a normal vessel lumen in which unactivated leukocytes, red cells and platelets circulate freely past quiescent endothelial cells, with no adhesion, aggregates or procoagulant mediators. It serves as the baseline for comparison with the activated thromboinflammatory milieu of myeloproliferative neoplasms shown in Figure 1B. Note that the image is Figure 1A, whereas the title and description refer to Figure 1B.

63016.recognize_zh: 這是骨髓抹片鐵染色（Prussian blue）加核固紅對染，背景偏藍綠色，有核細胞呈粉紅色；可見少數細胞旁有藍色鐵顆粒，但此解析度下看不清楚典型環繞細胞核的環狀鐵粒幼紅血球（ring sideroblast），需配合臨床的 40% 環狀鐵粒與 SF3B1 突變判讀。
features: Bone marrow aspirate smear with Prussian blue iron stain and nuclear fast red counterstain
Mixed nucleated cells including erythroid precursors with round nuclei and segmented neutrophils
Only a few scattered fine blue siderotic granules visible
Perinuclear ring distribution of iron granules not convincingly resolved at this magnification
Abundant background red cell ghosts and blue-green cast from the stain
63016.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear stained for iron (Prussian blue with nuclear fast red counterstain) shows a mixed population of nucleated cells, including erythroid precursors and segmented granulocytes, on a background of red cell debris. A few scattered blue siderotic granules are present, but a clear perinuclear ring of granules encircling erythroblast nuclei is not well resolved in this photomicrograph, likely owing to magnification and color balance. Ring sideroblasts should be counted at high power as erythroblasts with at least five granules covering at least one-third of the nuclear circumference. With the reported 40% ring sideroblasts and SF3B1 mutation, the case is consistent with MDS with low blasts and SF3B1 mutation (formerly refractory anemia with ring sideroblasts).

ddx.vs: Congenital forms present in young patients with microcytic anemia and lack SF3B1 mutation, whereas this elderly patient has macrocytic anemia with SF3B1.

ddx.dx: Acquired reversible sideroblastic anemia (copper deficiency, zinc excess, alcohol, isoniazid)
ddx.vs: Secondary causes show ring sideroblasts without a clonal SF3B1 mutation and resolve after removing the cause; copper deficiency also shows vacuolated precursors.

ddx.dx: MDS/MPN with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: This entity has ring sideroblasts plus platelets of 450 x 10^9/L or more with MPN-type megakaryocytes, which is not described here.

63016.stain: Prussian blue (iron stain) with nuclear fast red

62952.recognize_zh: Cyclin D1 染色下，大多數中型腫瘤細胞呈核內棕色陽性（強度不一，由弱到中等），少數細胞為藍色陰性；B 細胞淋巴瘤出現核 cyclin D1 陽性是被套細胞淋巴瘤的關鍵證據（反映 t(11;14)）。
features: Nuclear cyclin D1 staining in the majority of intermediate-sized tumor cells
Variable intensity from weak to moderate, with a few strongly staining nuclei
Interspersed negative nuclei (likely reactive T cells and histiocytes)
Round to slightly irregular nuclei in dense sheets
Faint cytoplasmic blush in background, nuclear staining is the relevant pattern
62952.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for cyclin D1 shows nuclear positivity in the majority of neoplastic lymphoid cells, with weak to moderate and somewhat heterogeneous intensity. Scattered negative nuclei, likely reactive cells, are interspersed. Nuclear cyclin D1 expression in a CD5-positive B-cell lymphoma is consistent with mantle cell lymphoma; FISH for CCND1 rearrangement can confirm t(11;14) when staining is weak.

ddx.vs: Myeloma cells are cyclin D1+ but show plasmacytic morphology, CD138/MUM1 positivity, and lack CD20 and CD5.
HCL shows weak cyclin D1 with abundant pale cytoplasm and is CD5-, annexin A1+, BRAF V600E+.
Paraimmunoblasts in proliferation centers may be weakly cyclin D1+, but the diffuse population is cyclin D1- and LEF1+.
Morphology is identical but cyclin D1 is absent; SOX11 positivity and CCND2/CCND3 rearrangements establish the diagnosis.

62824.recognize_zh: GATA3 免疫染色下，大多數腫瘤細胞的細胞核呈棕色陽性（強度由中等到強），胞質不染；夾雜少數藍色陰性核的背景細胞。核染色陽性的 GATA3 支持乳癌（或尿路上皮癌）來源，而非漿細胞腫瘤。
features: IHC for GATA3 on a marrow core diffusely infiltrated by tumor cells
Nuclear staining in the majority of tumor cells, with variable moderate to strong intensity
Round-to-oval nuclei, some eccentric, with no cytoplasmic staining
Interspersed smaller GATA3-negative cells with blue hematoxylin nuclei
Discohesive arrangement without gland formation
62824.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for GATA3 on the bone marrow core shows moderate-to-strong nuclear positivity in the majority of the infiltrating tumor cells, with no cytoplasmic staining. Smaller interspersed background cells are negative. GATA3 is a lineage-associated transcription factor expressed in breast and urothelial carcinomas, and together with the plasmacytoid discohesive morphology and cytoplasmic p120, the findings support metastatic breast (lobular) carcinoma. Note that GATA3 is also expressed by T cells, so lymphoid lineage must be excluded with other markers.

ddx.vs: Myeloma cells are GATA3 negative and instead show CD138/MUM1 positivity with kappa or lambda restriction.
Urothelial carcinoma is also GATA3 positive but is typically ER negative and positive for uroplakin, p63 and CK20 rather than ER/mammaglobin.
PTCL expresses GATA3 but is CD3 positive and cytokeratin negative, with lymphoid rather than plasmacytoid epithelial cytology.

62760.recognize_zh: 淋巴結呈結節狀，濾泡 BCL6 陽性且 BCL2 在濾泡內也強陽性（濾泡性淋巴瘤）；cyclin D1 染色則只在濾泡周圍外套層內側形成一圈陽性細胞，加上流式有一小群 CD5+ kappa 限制 B 細胞，代表合併原位外套細胞腫瘤（isMCN）。
features: Nodular architecture with closely packed follicles effacing the lymph node (H&E)
Neoplastic follicles BCL6-positive and aberrantly BCL2-positive, consistent with follicular lymphoma
Cyclin D1-positive cells confined to a thin rim in the inner mantle zones around follicles, without expansion
Flow cytometry: small distinct CD19+ CD5+ B-cell subset (gated) with kappa light chain restriction
Additional CD19+ CD5-negative B-cell population separate from the CD5+ subset
62760.describe_en: Lymph node sections show a nodular proliferation of closely packed follicles effacing the normal architecture. Immunostains show that the follicles are BCL6-positive with aberrant BCL2 expression, consistent with follicular lymphoma. Cyclin D1 highlights a rim of positive cells restricted to the inner mantle zones surrounding the follicles, without an expanded or diffuse cyclin D1-positive infiltrate. Flow cytometry identifies a small separate CD19+ CD5+ kappa-restricted B-cell population in addition to CD5-negative B cells. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma with composite in situ mantle cell neoplasia; SOX11 staining and CCND1 FISH may further characterize the mantle cell component.

ddx.dx: Overt mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: Mantle zone pattern MCL shows expanded, broad cyclin D1-positive mantles, whereas isMCN positive cells are confined to a thin inner mantle rim without architectural distortion.
Reactive germinal centers are BCL2-negative with polarization and tingible body macrophages, and cyclin D1-positive mantle cells are absent.
CLL/SLL is also CD5-positive but is cyclin D1-negative, CD23-positive, and forms proliferation centers rather than a mantle zone rim.

ddx.dx: Cyclin D1-positive endothelial or histiocytic cells
ddx.vs: Weak cyclin D1 staining in endothelial cells or histiocytes is scattered and non-lymphoid, whereas isMCN cells are small lymphocytes aligned in the inner mantle and co-express CD5 and SOX11.

62760.stain: H&E; IHC: BCL6, BCL2, cyclin D1; flow cytometry

62696.recognize_zh: 淋巴球 gate 的 CD3 對 CD57 流式圖：綠色 CD3 陰性族群 CD57 均一強陽性（約 10^2），形成緊密團塊；藍色 T 細胞只有部分 CD57 陽性，表示擴增的是 CD57+ NK 細胞。
features: Dot plot gated on lymphocytes: CD3-PC5.5 (x) versus CD57-FITC (y)
Tight green CD3-negative population with uniformly bright CD57 (~10^1.5 to 10^2)
Blue CD3-positive T cells mostly CD57 negative with a smaller CD57-positive tail
Magenta CD3-negative, CD57-negative population (B cells) near origin, with scattered intermediate events
Homogeneous CD57 intensity on the NK population suggests a mature, restricted NK subset
62696.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of the lymphocyte gate displays CD3 versus CD57. A prominent, tightly clustered surface CD3-negative population with uniformly bright CD57 expression is present, in addition to CD3-positive T cells that are mostly CD57 negative with a minor CD57-positive subset and a double-negative B-cell population. The expanded homogeneous CD3-negative CD57-positive population represents mature NK cells. Findings are consistent with the reported chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells.

ddx.vs: T-LGL shows expansion of CD3-positive, CD8-positive, CD57-positive cells, whereas the CD57-bright population here is CD3 negative.
Reactive NK cells show heterogeneous CD57 and polyclonal KIR expression, whereas clonality surrogates (KIR restriction) are needed to support CLPD-NK.
ANKL cells are usually CD56 bright and CD57 negative, unlike this CD57-bright mature NK population.

62632.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中，紅血球分布大致均勻，白血球與血小板在視野中很少；箭頭標示處為淡染、邊界模糊的紅血球樣結構與小團紅血球，可能代表血管內溶血後的紅血球「鬼影」（ghost cells），但此倍率無法確認細節。
features: Low-power field of normochromic red cells in a monolayer
Very few leukocytes and scarce platelets in the field, suggesting cytopenias
Arrows mark pale, poorly outlined red cell structures and a small red cell cluster
No obvious spherocytes, schistocytes or nucleated red cells resolvable at this magnification
Magnification too low to assess red cell morphology in detail
62632.describe_en: Low-power peripheral blood smear shows a monolayer of normochromic red cells with very few leukocytes and scarce platelets in the field, raising the possibility of cytopenias. The arrows highlight pale, poorly outlined red cell structures and a small cluster of red cells, which may represent lysed red cell ghosts reflecting intravascular hemolysis, although detail is not resolvable at this magnification. No schistocytes or spherocytes can be assessed reliably. The findings are nonspecific but compatible with an intravascular hemolytic process such as paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria, which requires flow cytometric confirmation.

ddx.vs: Shows prominent irregular red cell agglutinates throughout the smear, with a positive DAT for C3 and high-titer cold agglutinins.
Intravascular hemolysis with numerous schistocytes and severe thrombocytopenia on higher power.
Pancytopenia without hemolysis; LDH, reticulocyte count and hemosiderinuria are normal and FLAER/CD59 expression is intact.

62504.recognize_zh: 低倍下骨髓幾乎被小淋巴球完全取代，只剩零星巨核細胞與脂肪空泡，其間可見較淡染的模糊區塊（增生中心，proliferation centers），是 CLL/SLL 瀰漫性骨髓侵犯的樣貌。
features: Packed marrow with near-total replacement by a monotonous population of small dark lymphocytes
Vague, paler-staining zones suggestive of proliferation centers (larger cells with more cytoplasm)
Only scattered residual megakaryocytes and few fat spaces
Diffuse growth pattern without discrete follicles
62504.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with diffuse replacement by small lymphocytes. Vague pale zones composed of slightly larger cells, suggestive of proliferation centers, interrupt the dark background. Residual hematopoiesis is reduced to scattered megakaryocytes, and fat is nearly absent. Findings are consistent with diffuse marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma shows paratrabecular aggregates of cleaved centrocytes and is CD10/BCL6 positive, rather than diffuse replacement with pale proliferation centers.
Mantle cell lymphoma lacks true proliferation centers and is cyclin D1 positive.
Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma contains plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with increased mast cells and usually an IgM paraprotein, and is CD5/CD23 negative.

62440.recognize_zh: 視野中央的嗜中性球核分成約 6–7 葉（正常最多 5 葉），細胞質含淡紫色細顆粒；背景紅血球偏大且有橢圓形者，符合巨母細胞性貧血的過度分葉嗜中性球（hypersegmented neutrophil）。
features: Mature neutrophil, slightly enlarged, with a nucleus divided into approximately 6-7 discrete lobes
Lobes connected by thin chromatin strands; coarse, condensed chromatin
Pale cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules
Background red cells are relatively large with some oval forms (suggesting macro-ovalocytes)
62440.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with abnormal nuclear hypersegmentation, the nucleus comprising approximately six to seven lobes joined by thin chromatin filaments, with normal-appearing fine cytoplasmic granulation. The surrounding erythrocytes are relatively large and include oval forms, although red cell size is best confirmed by MCV. A neutrophil with six or more lobes (or more than 5% with five lobes) is abnormal. Findings are consistent with a hypersegmented neutrophil, suggestive of megaloblastic anemia (vitamin B12 or folate deficiency) in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: Normal neutrophils have 3-4 (at most 5) lobes, whereas this cell has six or more.

ddx.dx: Hereditary neutrophil hypersegmentation or drug effect (e.g., hydroxyurea, methotrexate)
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so distinction relies on normal B12/folate levels, family studies, or drug history.
Macropolycytes are roughly twice normal size with a proportionally large nucleus, whereas hypersegmentation defines lobe number rather than cell size, although both occur in megaloblastic states.
Pelger-Huet neutrophils show the opposite change, with hyposegmented bilobed or round nuclei.

62376.recognize_zh: 流式細胞儀母細胞閘中 CD34 對 CD7 作圖，CD34 陽性母細胞有相當比例延伸到 CD7 陽性象限，表示骨髓系母細胞帶有異常 CD7 表現，這在 3q26（MECOM）重組 AML 中常見。
features: Dot plot gated on blasts: CD34-PC7 (y-axis) versus CD7-APC700 (x-axis)
CD34-positive blast cluster spans the CD7 threshold, with a large fraction in the CD34+CD7+ quadrant
Continuous smear from CD7-negative to dim/moderate CD7 expression rather than a discrete bright CD7+ population
Minimal CD34-CD7+ events (1.04%); separate CD34-negative/CD7-negative population below
62376.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on blasts shows CD34 versus CD7. A substantial proportion of the CD34-positive blasts show dim to moderate CD7 expression, forming a continuum across the quadrant gate, whereas CD34-negative CD7-positive events are rare (1.04%). This represents aberrant CD7 expression on myeloid blasts, an aberrancy frequently reported in AML with inv(3)/t(3;3). Percentages for the CD34+CD7+ quadrant are not labeled on this plot.

ddx.vs: ETP-ALL is CD7+ with stem/myeloid markers but expresses cytoplasmic CD3 and lacks MPO, which must be tested on the full panel.
A small subset of normal CD34+ precursors can express CD7, but they are few and show a normal maturation pattern rather than an expanded homogeneous blast cluster.

62312.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度增加，腫瘤細胞核圓形或腎形、彼此被清亮細胞質隔開，呈「荷包蛋」（fried-egg）樣外觀，正常造血細胞明顯減少，是毛狀細胞白血病（HCL）的典型骨髓切片。
features: Hypercellular marrow with a diffuse interstitial infiltrate replacing normal hematopoiesis
Small to medium cells with round, oval or reniform nuclei and bland chromatin
Abundant clear cytoplasm with distinct cell borders keeping nuclei widely spaced ('fried-egg' appearance)
Inconspicuous nucleoli and absent mitotic activity
Scattered extravasated red cells; residual hematopoietic elements markedly reduced
62312.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular and shows a diffuse interstitial infiltrate that effaces much of the normal hematopoietic tissue. At high power the infiltrate consists of small to medium-sized cells with round to reniform nuclei, bland chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, separated by abundant clear cytoplasm with well-defined cell borders, imparting a 'fried-egg' appearance. Extravasated red cells are present in the background, and mitoses are not evident. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by hairy cell leukemia; reticulin stain and immunohistochemistry (CD20, annexin A1, TRAP, cyclin D1, BRAF V600E) are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Mast cell lesions form paratrabecular/perivascular aggregates of spindled cells with fibrosis and eosinophils, and are CD117/tryptase positive and CD20 negative.
SMZL cells have scant cytoplasm and form nodular or intrasinusoidal infiltrates rather than widely spaced fried-egg cells, and are annexin A1 negative.
Hypocellular marrows lack a monotonous infiltrate of CD20+ B cells and do not show the fried-egg spacing pattern.
HCL-v shows more intrasinusoidal involvement and cells with prominent nucleoli, and is annexin A1 and BRAF V600E negative.

62248.recognize_zh: p63 核染色在淋巴小葉內呈散在的棕色細胞核，勾勒出小葉周邊與隔膜的上皮網絡，而甲狀腺濾泡上皮為陰性，顯示淋巴球之間有胸腺上皮細胞（thymic epithelial cells）。
features: Scattered nuclear p63-positive cells distributed throughout the lymphoid lobules, accentuated at the lobular periphery and along septa
Positive nuclei outline small lobules and rim the lymphoid nests (epithelial meshwork pattern)
Background lymphocytes are p63-negative
Thyroid follicular epithelium is p63-negative
Linear knife-line and fold artifacts traverse the section
62248.describe_en: p63 immunohistochemistry shows scattered nuclear-positive cells dispersed within the lymphoid lobules, concentrated at the lobular periphery and along fibrovascular septa, while the lymphocytes and the intermixed thyroid follicles are negative. This pattern highlights an intact thymic epithelial cell meshwork within the lymphoid tissue. Findings support thymic tissue, consistent with a cervical thymic remnant with intermixed ectopic thyroid tissue.

ddx.dx: Lymph node with metastatic squamous cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Metastatic carcinoma forms cohesive p63-positive nests with cytologic atypia that replace nodal tissue, whereas here p63-positive cells are single, bland, and evenly spaced within lymphoid lobules.

ddx.dx: Solid cell nests of the thyroid (ultimobranchial body remnants)
ddx.vs: Solid cell nests are small p63-positive epithelial clusters within thyroid without an accompanying TdT-positive thymocyte population.

62184.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中大量小而成熟、染色質濃密的淋巴球（CLL 背景），其間散布許多體積大兩到三倍、細胞質中度嗜鹼性、核仁可見的大型淋巴樣細胞，部分帶尾狀細胞質，提示 CLL 發生大細胞轉化（Richter transformation）。
features: Numerous small mature lymphocytes with dense clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm (CLL background)
Scattered large lymphoid cells, 2–3 times the size of small lymphocytes, with moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Large cells have round nuclei with finer chromatin and occasional nucleoli; some show tailed (hand-mirror) cytoplasm, likely smear artifact
Occasional binucleate/bilobed granulocyte and rare neutrophil
Numerous echinocytes (crenated red cells) in the background
62184.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows lymphocytosis composed of small mature lymphocytes with condensed chromatin, together with numerous scattered large lymphoid cells two to three times their size. The large cells have moderate basophilic cytoplasm, round nuclei with more open chromatin and occasional nucleoli, and several show tailed cytoplasmic projections. Red cells show crenation artifact. The presence of a prominent large-cell population in a CLL background raises concern for large-cell (Richter) transformation, which requires tissue biopsy for confirmation as diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes are medium-sized with a single central prominent nucleolus and condensed chromatin, whereas DLBCL-type cells are larger with more abundant basophilic cytoplasm; tissue biopsy establishes Richter transformation.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic neoplasm / mantle cell lymphoma leukemic phase
ddx.vs: Leukemic MCL shows cyclin D1/SOX11 positivity with t(11;14), and prolymphocytic proliferations lack the underlying small CLL cell population.

ddx.dx: Reactive large granular or activated lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant pale cytoplasm hugging red cells and polyclonal markers, not monotonous basophilic large cells in a CLL background.

62120.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有大型泡沫細胞（foam cell），胞質充滿大小均一的清亮小空泡、呈肥皂泡狀，並散在細小藍色顆粒，細胞核小而圓，符合 Niemann-Pick 病的脂質堆積巨噬細胞。
features: Large histiocyte(s) many times the size of surrounding cells, with abundant cytoplasm
Cytoplasm filled with numerous small, fairly uniform clear vacuoles giving a foamy, soap-bubble appearance
Scattered fine blue-staining granules among the vacuoles
Small round nuclei compressed within the foamy cytoplasm; overlapping cells obscure some detail
Background of maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors
62120.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large foamy histiocyte, possibly two overlapping cells, with abundant cytoplasm distended by numerous small uniform clear vacuoles and scattered fine blue granules. The nuclei are small and round, and overlapping hematopoietic cells partly obscure the cell outline. The background shows maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors. Findings are consistent with lipid-laden foam cells of a lysosomal storage disorder; in an infant with developmental delay and hepatosplenomegaly and deficient enzyme activity, this supports Niemann-Pick disease.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillary crumpled tissue paper cytoplasm with striations rather than uniform bubbly vacuoles.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain prominent blue-green ceroid granules on Giemsa, whereas Niemann-Pick cells are predominantly foamy with only scant blue granules.
Reactive foamy macrophages are scattered and accompany lipid disorders or cell turnover without infantile neurologic disease and deficient acid sphingomyelinase.

ddx.dx: Metastatic signet-ring or clear cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are cohesive with atypical nuclei and are keratin positive, unlike bland CD68-positive foam cells.

62056.recognize_zh: 中低倍 H&E 下淋巴結呈瀰漫性浸潤，看不到明顯結節，小淋巴球之間夾雜散在的大型淡染細胞與上皮樣組織球；這種 T 細胞與組織球豐富的瀰漫背景是 NLPHL 變異型態或進展時需注意的外觀。
features: Diffuse lymphoid infiltrate effacing the architecture without discernible nodules in this field
Predominance of small mature lymphocytes
Scattered larger cells with pale cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei
Interspersed epithelioid histiocytes and small vessels with pink cytoplasm
No necrosis or sheets of large cells at this magnification
62056.describe_en: H&E section of lymph node at intermediate magnification shows diffuse effacement by a lymphoid infiltrate composed predominantly of small lymphocytes with scattered larger cells having pale cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei, admixed with epithelioid histiocytes. Well-formed nodules are not evident in this field, and confluent sheets of large cells are not seen. Cytologic detail of the large cells is limited at this magnification. In the context of the referenced case, the findings are consistent with a diffuse T-cell/histiocyte-rich variant pattern of nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma; immunostains are required to exclude T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: H&E cannot reliably separate them; absence of any residual small-B-cell nodules and CD21+ FDC meshworks favors THRLBCL.
cHL large cells are CD30+/CD15+ and CD20 weak/negative, while LP cells are CD20+ and CD30/CD15 negative.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with epithelioid histiocytes (lymphoepithelioid variant)
ddx.vs: Lennert lymphoma shows cytologically atypical small T cells with clonal TCR rearrangement and lacks large CD20+ LP cells.

61992.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 EBER 原位雜交中，整片細胞核幾乎都是藍色背景染色，只有極少數（約 2–3 個）小細胞核呈深棕黑色陽性；罕見的 EBER 陽性細胞代表骨髓中僅有少量 EBV 感染的淋巴球。
features: Hypercellular marrow biopsy with trilineage hematopoiesis and fat spaces
Rare small cells with crisp dark brown-black nuclear EBER signal (about 2-3 in the field)
Positive signal is strictly nuclear; no cytoplasmic or background staining
Megakaryocytes and myeloid/erythroid precursors are negative
No clusters or sheets of EBER-positive cells
61992.describe_en: EBER in situ hybridization on a hypercellular bone marrow biopsy with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis shows only rare scattered small cells with crisp nuclear positivity, about two to three in this field. Megakaryocytes and myeloid and erythroid precursors are negative, and no clusters or sheets of positive cells are identified. Rare EBER-positive lymphocytes are consistent with recent or reactivated EBV infection; there is no morphologic evidence of an EBV-positive lymphoproliferative disorder in this field.

ddx.vs: EBV-driven lymphoproliferations show numerous or clustered EBER-positive cells, often large and atypical, rather than a few scattered small positive nuclei.
Marrow Hodgkin lymphoma shows EBER positivity in large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a fibrotic, mixed inflammatory background, which is absent here.
These show many EBER-positive T or NK cells with elevated blood EBV DNA and hemophagocytosis rather than rare positive cells.

61928.recognize_zh: 腦實質（神經膠網與膠質細胞）中一條小血管的管腔被大型、核大而空泡狀的淋巴樣細胞塞滿，周圍腦組織內幾乎沒有腫瘤細胞浸潤；這種「腫瘤細胞只在血管內」的分布是血管內大B細胞淋巴瘤（IVLBCL）的特徵。
features: Small vessel lumen distended by a cohesive-appearing cluster of large atypical lymphoid cells
Tumor cells have round-to-irregular nuclei about 2-3 times a small lymphocyte, vesicular chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and scant cytoplasm
Neoplastic cells confined to the vascular lumen, lined by flattened endothelium, with no extravascular tumor mass
Surrounding brain parenchyma shows neuropil with glial nuclei and neurons, without significant infiltrate
A second small vessel at lower left contains only red cells and scattered nucleated cells
61928.describe_en: Sections of brain parenchyma show a small vessel whose lumen is expanded by a cluster of large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin, irregular nuclear contours and scant cytoplasm. The atypical cells are confined within the vascular lumen, and the surrounding neuropil shows no appreciable parenchymal infiltrate or mass lesion. The morphology is suggestive of intravascular large B-cell lymphoma; immunohistochemistry (CD20, CD3) is needed to confirm B-cell lineage and exclude intravascular carcinoma or other intravascular hematolymphoid neoplasms.

ddx.vs: Morphology is similar, but intravascular NK/T-cell lymphoma is CD20-negative and CD3epsilon/CD56/cytotoxic marker-positive with EBER positivity.
