Carcinoma emboli form cohesive nests with more cytoplasm and are cytokeratin-positive and CD45-negative.
Leukostasis shows blasts with fine chromatin in many vessels together with a markedly elevated peripheral blast count, and the cells express blast markers (CD34, MPO) rather than CD20.

ddx.dx: Primary CNS diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Primary CNS DLBCL forms parenchymal masses with an angiocentric, perivascular cuffing pattern rather than being confined to vessel lumina.

61864.recognize_zh: 同一視野中三個嗜中性球的核都分成 6 葉以上（hypersegmented neutrophils），背景紅血球有淚滴狀、橢圓形等大小與形狀不一的變化並有大型血小板；在 JAK2 陽性骨髓增生性腫瘤中，須考慮 hydroxyurea 等藥物或合併葉酸/B12 缺乏。
features: Three neutrophils each with six or more nuclear lobes (hypersegmentation)
Neutrophils of normal to slightly increased size with fine pink granular cytoplasm
Marked anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells (dacrocytes) and elliptocytes
Large/giant platelet and a platelet clump
Background with scattered normal-sized platelets
61864.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three neutrophils in a single field, each with six or more nuclear lobes, meeting criteria for neutrophil hypersegmentation. The red cells show marked anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells and elliptocytes, and there is a large platelet and a platelet clump. No blasts or nucleated red cells are seen in this field. In a JAK2-positive myeloproliferative neoplasm, hypersegmentation raises the possibility of hydroxyurea (or other antimetabolite) effect or concurrent vitamin B12/folate deficiency, while the teardrop cells may reflect marrow fibrosis. Findings are consistent with hypersegmented neutrophils in a JAK2-positive myeloproliferative neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia also shows hypersegmented neutrophils but with macro-ovalocytes, raised MCV and low B12/folate levels rather than JAK2 positivity and teardrop cells.
Drug-induced hypersegmentation occurs with macrocytosis in treated patients and is identified by medication history rather than morphology alone.
This benign autosomal dominant trait shows hypersegmentation in a proportion of neutrophils in otherwise normal blood without poikilocytosis or a clonal marker.
PMF shows leukoerythroblastosis with teardrop cells and giant platelets but does not itself cause consistent neutrophil hypersegmentation.

61800.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 骨髓切片中，骨小樑之間幾乎完全被造血細胞填滿、脂肪細胞近乎消失，細胞密度接近 100%，屬於明顯高細胞性骨髓；細胞種類與發育不良需高倍確認。
features: Low-power view of bone marrow core with intact bony trabeculae
Markedly hypercellular marrow (near 100%) with near-complete loss of adipocytes
Heterogeneous population of hematopoietic cells packed in the intertrabecular space
Scattered small vessels and interstitial red cells
Cytologic detail and lineage cannot be resolved at this magnification
61800.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow, approaching 100% cellularity, with near-complete effacement of fat between intact bony trabeculae. The intertrabecular space is filled by a dense, heterogeneous hematopoietic population with scattered small vessels. At this magnification lineage composition, dysplasia and blast content cannot be assessed and require high-power examination and immunohistochemistry. In the GATA2 proband with CMML, findings are consistent with a hypercellular marrow involved by a myeloid neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Hypocellular MDS/aplastic-like marrow of GATA2 deficiency
ddx.vs: Many GATA2 patients have hypocellular marrow, whereas this core is markedly hypercellular, favoring an overt proliferative neoplasm.
AML shows monotonous sheets of blasts on high power and CD34/CD117 staining, which cannot be judged at this magnification.
Reactive marrow retains normal maturation and topography without dysplasia, cytopenia pattern or clonal abnormality.

61736.recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E 下組織被片狀的中到大型非典型淋巴樣細胞取代，核泡狀、細胞質少到中量，其間夾雜不規則的粉紅色纖維素樣/壞死物質與小血管，反應性小淋巴球背景相對少；這種片狀大細胞合併壞死，符合高級別的淋巴瘤樣肉芽腫病，需以 EBER 與 CD20 確認。
features: Dense, sheet-like infiltrate of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei and scant to moderate cytoplasm
Scattered larger cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei and occasional mitotic-appearing figures
Irregular geographic zones of pink fibrinoid/necrotic material and stroma interspersed within the infiltrate
Small vessels within the infiltrate; angiocentricity is not clearly resolved at this magnification
Relatively few small reactive lymphocytes compared with the atypical population; no well-formed granulomas
61736.describe_en: Sections show a dense, sheet-like infiltrate of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei and scant to moderate cytoplasm, admixed with fewer small lymphocytes and histiocytes. Irregular areas of fibrinoid necrosis and stroma are interspersed, and small vessels are present, although transmural angioinvasion is not clearly demonstrated at this magnification. No well-formed granulomas are seen. In the stated context, the findings are consistent with lymphomatoid granulomatosis with a large-cell-rich (high-grade) appearance, to be graded by the density of EBER-positive CD20-positive large B cells.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: Forms monotonous sheets of large EBV+ B cells without the angiocentric, necrotizing extranodal (lung) presentation that defines LYG, though grade 3 LYG overlaps morphologically.
Is angiodestructive, necrotic and EBV positive but the tumor cells are CD56+ cytoplasmic CD3+ and CD20 negative.
Lacks atypical large lymphoid cells and instead shows neutrophilic microabscesses, palisading histiocytes and giant cells with ANCA positivity.
Shows cohesive sheets of hallmark cells with strong uniform CD30 and T-cell/ALK markers and is EBER negative.

61672.recognize_zh: 這是四格合成圖：A 的 HPLC 在最前端出現兩個提早沖提的尖峰（fast-moving/pre-integration peaks）且 HbA2 偏低（2.0%），B 的超活體染色（HbH 染色）可見許多紅血球內含藍色點狀包涵體，C/D 為 α2 基因 polyadenylation 訊號 AATAAA 缺兩個鹼基的定序圖，整體支持非缺失型 HbH 疾病。
features: Panel A: HPLC chromatogram with two sharp early-eluting peaks near time zero before integration, P2 3.7%, P3 2.7%, A0 91.6%, HbA2 2.0% and HbF 0.0%

Panel B: supravital (brilliant cresyl blue type) preparation with many red cells containing blue-staining inclusions; fine evenly spaced golf-ball stippling cannot be resolved clearly at this magnification and some coarser clumps likely represent reticulocytes
Panel C: Sanger sequence chromatogram with the highlighted normal AATAAA polyadenylation signal
Panel D: patient chromatogram with a clean, single-peaked sequence showing the AATA-- two-base deletion, consistent with homozygosity
Low-normal to reduced HbA2 fraction without increased HbF
61672.describe_en: This composite combines hemoglobin analysis, a supravital red cell preparation and DNA sequencing. The HPLC chromatogram (A) shows two fast-eluting pre-integration peaks with HbA2 of 2.0% and no increase in HbF, a pattern suggestive of HbH (beta4 tetramers) and Hb Bart's rather than beta-thalassemia trait. The supravital preparation (B) shows numerous red cells with blue-staining inclusions compatible with HbH precipitates, although the characteristic golf-ball stippling is not well resolved at this magnification. Sequencing (C, D) demonstrates a homozygous two-base deletion of the alpha2-globin polyadenylation signal (AATAAA to AATA--, HBA2:c.*93_*94delAA) compared with the normal sequence. Findings are consistent with non-deletional HbH disease due to homozygous alpha-thalassemia polyadenylation signal mutation.

ddx.vs: Beta-thalassemia trait shows an elevated HbA2 (usually above 3.5%) without fast-moving HbH/Bart's peaks or HbH inclusions.
Deletional HbH disease has a similar HPLC and inclusion pattern and is separated only by gap-PCR or MLPA showing alpha-globin gene deletions rather than a point mutation on sequencing.

ddx.dx: Unstable hemoglobin variant with Heinz bodies
ddx.vs: Heinz bodies are fewer, larger, eccentric membrane-bound inclusions seen with methyl violet stain, unlike the diffuse multiple HbH precipitates, and sequencing identifies a structural globin mutation.
Reticulocytes show coarse filamentous or reticular blue-staining RNA networks rather than fine uniform golf-ball inclusions, and HPLC lacks fast-moving peaks.

61672.stain: HPLC; supravital HbH stain; Sanger sequencing

61608.recognize_zh: PD-L1 染色中圓核的腫瘤細胞片狀排列卻呈陰性，棕色膜/胞質染色集中在散在、細胞質豐富且有突起的組織球（巨噬細胞）；判讀時要分清陽性是腫瘤細胞還是腫瘤相關巨噬細胞。
features: Sheets of tumor cells with round nuclei and no PD-L1 membranous staining
Strong membranous and cytoplasmic PD-L1 in scattered large cells with abundant cytoplasm and dendritic processes (histiocytes/macrophages)
Positive macrophages distributed in a network between tumor cells
Light nonspecific background cytoplasmic tint in tumor cells
61608.describe_en: PD-L1 immunostain shows the neoplastic cells to be essentially negative, whereas scattered tumor-associated histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm and dendritic processes show strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining. The positive cells form a loose interstitial network among the tumor sheets. PD-L1 expression in this field is therefore attributable to the immune microenvironment rather than tumor cells. The stain is ancillary and not diagnostic; the diagnosis of EBV-positive plasmablastic lymphoma rests on morphology, CD20 negativity, MUM1/CD138 and EBER.

ddx.vs: True tumor-cell positivity shows membranous staining on the round-nucleated neoplastic cells themselves, not on large histiocytes with dendritic cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma / classic Hodgkin lymphoma
ddx.vs: These characteristically show PD-L1 on tumor cells because of 9p24.1 alterations, and are CD20 or CD30/CD15 positive rather than plasmablastic.
Often PD-L1 positive in tumor cells and microenvironment but retains CD20/PAX5 expression.

61544.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD15 染色中，上方大型 HRS 細胞呈細顆粒狀胞質與核旁點狀陽性、核大而核仁明顯；周圍零星強陽性的小圓細胞是顆粒球系細胞，可作內部陽性對照。
features: Large atypical cell with a large vesicular nucleus, prominent nucleolus and granular cytoplasmic/paranuclear CD15 staining
Scattered smaller cells with strong diffuse cytoplasmic CD15 (granulocytes/myeloid cells, internal positive control)
Background lymphocytes, histiocytes and stromal cells negative
Loose fibrotic stroma with no sheets of positive large cells
61544.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD15 on a bone marrow biopsy highlights a large atypical cell with a vesicular nucleus and prominent nucleolus showing granular cytoplasmic and paranuclear staining. Scattered smaller cells with strong diffuse staining represent granulocytic cells and serve as an internal positive control. The remaining lymphocytes, histiocytes and stromal cells are negative. CD15 expression in the large cells, together with CD30 positivity, weak PAX5 and CD20 negativity, supports classic Hodgkin lymphoma involving marrow.

ddx.vs: ALCL is usually CD15-negative (or weak in a minority) and PAX5-negative with EMA/ALK or T-cell antigen expression.
LP cells are CD15- and CD30-negative with strong CD20 and PAX5, unlike these CD15-positive large cells.

ddx.dx: CD15-positive myeloid precursors misread as tumor cells
ddx.vs: Myelocytes and neutrophils are smaller with condensed or lobated nuclei and diffuse strong granular staining, while HRS cells are large with huge nucleoli and Golgi-pattern staining.

61480.recognize_zh: 周邊血中淋巴球數量明顯增加，細胞為中型、核圓或略不規則、染色質粗塊狀、細胞質中等量且淡藍，形態單一，提示成熟 B 細胞淋巴增生；標題所述類似 Auer 小體的嗜酸性棒狀結晶在此解析度下無法清楚辨認。
features: Marked lymphocytosis with monotonous intermediate-sized lymphoid cells, some in small clusters
Round to slightly irregular or indented nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin; occasional small nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale-to-light basophilic cytoplasm with smooth borders
Fine eosinophilic Auer rod-like crystalline inclusions are not clearly resolved at this image resolution
No smudge cells, blasts or plasmacytoid cells evident; red cells unremarkable
61480.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked lymphocytosis composed of a fairly monotonous population of intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, clumped chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and a moderate rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm. The fine eosinophilic, Auer rod-like crystalline inclusions described for this case are not clearly discernible at the resolution of this image and would need confirmation at higher magnification. No blasts or smudge cells are identified. With the reported monoclonal B-cell population on flow cytometry, findings are consistent with a mature B-cell lymphoma in leukemic phase; immunoglobulin crystal inclusions of this type favor lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma or another low-grade B-cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods
ddx.vs: True Auer rods occur in myeloblasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli and are MPO-positive, whereas these cells have clumped chromatin and the rods are immunoglobulin, MPO-negative.
CLL cells are smaller with scant cytoplasm, soccer-ball chromatin and numerous smudge cells, and are CD5+/CD23+ by flow.
MCL cells often show indented nuclei and are CD5+ with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression, which requires flow or IHC to exclude.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm hugging red cells and are polyclonal on flow, unlike this monotonous monoclonal population.

61416.recognize_zh: H&E 400x 為成片的大型淋巴細胞，核圓至卵圓、染色質空泡狀並有多個貼近核膜的核仁（類中心母細胞 centroblast），可見核分裂與凋亡小體，符合大B細胞淋巴瘤的細胞學。
features: Sheets of large lymphoid cells, nuclei about 2-3 times a small lymphocyte
Round to oval, occasionally indented or folded nuclei with vesicular chromatin
One to several small nucleoli, often membrane-bound (centroblast-like)
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm with indistinct borders
Frequent mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies; scattered small vessels and histiocytes
61416.describe_en: High-power section shows sheets of large lymphoid cells with round to oval vesicular nuclei, multiple small peripheral nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, consistent with centroblast-like morphology. Mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies are readily seen. No Reed-Sternberg cells, prominent starry-sky pattern or plasmablastic features are evident. Findings are consistent with a large B-cell lymphoma, and in the context of strong MUM1 expression and IRF4 rearrangement, with large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Cytologically identical; IRF4 break-apart FISH with strong MUM1 and young age defines the IRF4-rearranged entity.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with multiple small central nucleoli, squared-off basophilic cytoplasm and a starry-sky background.
FL 3B has follicles of centroblasts but is typically MUM1-negative and lacks IRF4 rearrangement.
ALCL shows hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and abundant cytoplasm, with strong CD30 and lack of B-cell markers.

61352.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中巨核細胞數量增加，多數為中至大型、細胞核呈圓形不分葉或僅輕微分葉（hypolobated/monolobated），在細胞質豐富的背景下特別醒目，這是 del(5q) 骨髓增生不良症候群的典型巨核細胞型態。
features: Increased megakaryocytes, medium to large, scattered singly and loosely
Megakaryocyte nuclei round, monolobated or hypolobated, eccentric or central
Abundant eosinophilic megakaryocytic cytoplasm with preserved size (not micromegakaryocytes)
Hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis including erythroid precursors and maturing granulocytes
No obvious sheets of blasts or megakaryocyte clusters with bizarre hyperlobation
61352.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis. Megakaryocytes are increased and are predominantly normal-sized to large with round, non-lobated or hypolobated nuclei and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm. Erythroid and granulocytic maturation is present, and no sheets of blasts are identified in this field. In the appropriate cytogenetic context, the megakaryocyte morphology is characteristic of myelodysplastic syndrome with isolated del(5q).

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are large with hyperlobated, staghorn nuclei rather than round monolobated nuclei, and del(5q) is absent.
These typically show micromegakaryocytes or separated nuclear lobes rather than uniform large hypolobated forms; karyotype separates them.

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with SF3B1 and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: MDS/MPN-SF3B1-T has ET/PMF-like hyperlobated megakaryocytes and ring sideroblasts, with SF3B1 mutation rather than isolated del(5q).

61288.recognize_zh: 周邊血中有四顆大型圓形母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻並可見核仁，細胞質中等量呈灰藍色、無顆粒；核常偏向一側、細胞質較多，符合單核母細胞（monoblast）。
features: Four large round blasts, about 2-2.5 times the diameter of red cells
Round, sometimes eccentric nuclei with fine lacy chromatin and one or more discernible nucleoli
Moderate rim of agranular gray-blue cytoplasm; no Auer rods
A small cell with a dense round nucleus to the right (small lymphocyte versus nucleated red cell) for size comparison
Red cells unremarkable; scattered platelets including a small clump; eyepiece photograph with modest resolution
61288.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several large circulating blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, discernible nucleoli and a moderate rim of agranular gray-blue cytoplasm. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are not seen. A small cell with dense chromatin and scattered platelets are present for comparison. Lineage assignment requires cytochemistry (nonspecific esterase) or flow cytometry. Findings are consistent with circulating monoblasts of acute monoblastic leukemia (AML M5a).

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation or without maturation
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts usually have scantier cytoplasm and are MPO-positive or NSE-negative, whereas monoblasts are NSE-positive with CD14/CD64/CD11c by flow.
Lymphoblasts are smaller with a very high N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm and express TdT with B- or T-lineage markers.
Megakaryoblasts may have cytoplasmic blebs and are CD41/CD61-positive rather than monocytic-marker positive.

ddx.dx: Large granular lymphocytes or reactive lymphocytes
ddx.vs: These have condensed chromatin without nucleoli and abundant pale cytoplasm often indented by adjacent red cells.

61224.recognize_zh: 小腸黏膜絨毛結構仍保留，但固有層（lamina propria）被大量形態單一、核深染且輪廓不規則的中小型淋巴樣細胞塞滿而撐寬，上皮完整並有杯狀細胞，提示淋巴瘤浸潤黏膜。
features: Small intestinal villi with intact columnar epithelium and goblet cells
Lamina propria markedly expanded by a dense, monotonous infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells
Lymphoid cells have hyperchromatic, slightly irregular to oval nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Scattered intraepithelial lymphocytes within villous epithelium
No ulceration, necrosis or angiodestruction evident in this field
61224.describe_en: H&E section of small intestinal mucosa shows preserved villous architecture with intact epithelium and goblet cells. The lamina propria is diffusely expanded by a dense, monotonous population of small to medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei and scant cytoplasm, with scattered intraepithelial lymphocytes. Ulceration, coagulative necrosis and angioinvasion, which are typical of extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, are not seen in this field. The findings indicate mucosal involvement by lymphoma; subtyping as extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma requires demonstration of cytoplasmic CD3, CD56, cytotoxic granule proteins and EBER positivity.

ddx.vs: Shows marked epitheliotropism with CD8+/CD56+ cells and is EBER negative, whereas ENKTL is EBER positive and often angiodestructive.
Arises with celiac-type villous atrophy and pleomorphic cells with inflammatory background, is typically CD56 negative and EBER negative.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate (e.g., celiac disease or infection)
ddx.vs: Reactive lamina propria is polymorphous with plasma cells and eosinophils rather than a monotonous atypical population, and lacks clonal TR rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract
ddx.vs: Composed of small bland cells with a very low Ki-67 index and EBER negativity, without destructive growth.

61160.recognize_zh: 大腸黏膜固有層被淡染的組織球樣細胞浸潤，高倍下細胞核有核溝、折疊或腎形，細胞質淡嗜酸性，夾雜嗜酸性球；免疫染色大片陽性，符合蘭格漢斯細胞組織球增生症（Langerhans cell histiocytosis）。
features: Panel A: colonic mucosa with intact crypts and a pale, expansile infiltrate in the lamina propria/submucosa
Panel B: sheets of medium-sized cells with oval, folded, grooved or reniform (coffee-bean) nuclei, fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct borders; scattered admixed eosinophils
Panels C/D: strong diffuse immunohistochemical positivity of the infiltrate, sparing the crypt epithelium (antigens not labeled; typically CD1a, langerin/CD207 or S100)
Panel E: weak cytoplasmic staining in lesional cells; panel F: brown staining of the lesion with green counterstain (consistent with a BRAF V600E-type mutation-specific or second IHC)
No necrosis or marked mitotic activity in the visible fields
61160.describe_en: Colonic mucosal biopsy shows intact crypts with an expansile, pale-staining infiltrate occupying the lamina propria. At high power the infiltrate consists of sheets of medium-sized histiocytoid cells with grooved, folded, or reniform nuclei, fine chromatin, and moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, with admixed eosinophils. Immunohistochemical stains show strong diffuse positivity of the lesional cells with sparing of the epithelium, and additional stains highlight the same population (antigens not labeled in the figure). Findings are consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis of the colon; CD1a and langerin positivity with BRAF p.V600E mutation supports the diagnosis, and systemic staging is recommended.

ddx.vs: These non-LCH histiocytoses lack nuclear grooves and are CD1a and langerin negative (Rosai-Dorfman S100+ with emperipolesis; ECD foamy CD163+ histiocytes).
Langerhans cell sarcoma has marked cytologic atypia, prominent nucleoli and high mitotic rate, unlike the bland grooved cells here.
Xanthoma cells are foamy CD68-positive macrophages with small round nuclei and are CD1a negative.

ddx.dx: Eosinophilic colitis or poorly differentiated carcinoma
ddx.vs: Eosinophilic colitis lacks sheets of grooved CD1a+ cells, and carcinoma cells are cohesive with cytokeratin positivity.

61096.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中以黃色虛線圈出一個密集的小型芽細胞樣結節；一種免疫染色（C）在圈內呈瀰漫陽性，另一種（D）的陽性細胞則大多分布在結節周邊、僅少量滲入圈內，呈現 CAR-T 治療後殘存白血病灶與周圍 T 細胞的空間關係。
features: Low power: hypercellular marrow with a well-demarcated, densely packed cellular nodule (outlined in yellow)
High power: sheets of small to intermediate cells with high N:C ratio and dark nuclei adjacent to fat spaces; arrow highlights a cell of interest (detail limited by resolution)
IHC panel C: diffuse strong positivity within the outlined nodule, consistent with a residual leukemic blast population (antibody not labeled)
IHC panel D: positive cells concentrated around the periphery of the nodule with only small clusters inside, pattern typical of a T-cell marker (antibody not labeled)
Image resolution limits cytologic detail and precise antibody identification
61096.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow containing a discrete, densely cellular nodule (outlined) composed of small to intermediate cells with high N:C ratios. An immunostain shows diffuse positivity within the nodule, whereas a second immunostain highlights a population of cells largely surrounding the nodule with only scattered small clusters within it. The antibodies are not labeled in the figure and cytologic detail is limited by image resolution. In a patient with B-lymphoblastic leukemia treated with CAR T cells, the pattern suggests a residual/relapsing blast focus with peripheral T-cell infiltration; correlation with CD19, CD22, TdT and CD3 stains and flow cytometry for antigen loss is required.

ddx.vs: Benign aggregates are small, well circumscribed and composed of mixed CD3+ T cells and CD20+ B cells without TdT/CD34 positivity or sheets of blasts.

ddx.dx: CD19-negative relapse / lineage switch after CAR-T
ddx.vs: Morphology cannot separate them; flow cytometry or IHC for CD19, CD22, CD79a and myeloid markers is needed to detect antigen escape or lineage switch.
Hematogones are interstitially scattered with a maturing immunophenotypic continuum rather than forming a cohesive dense nodule.

61032.recognize_zh: 流式散點圖中一群棕色的 T 細胞同時表現 CD5 與 CD10（空心箭頭），CD19 陰性；正常 T 細胞不表現 CD10，因此這群 CD10 陽性 T 細胞代表 TFH 表型的異常族群，支持 AITL；另有一小群綠色 CD19 陽性 B 細胞（實心箭頭）。
features: Lymphocyte-gated flow cytometry dot plots
Distinct brown population co-expressing CD5 and CD10 (open arrow), separate from CD10-negative CD5+ T cells
Brown population is CD19-negative, confirming T-cell lineage of the CD10+ cells
Small green CD19-positive B-cell population (solid arrow) displayed on kappa and lambda plots
Kappa vs lambda plots show the B cells with low light-chain expression; resolution of restriction is limited in this figure
61032.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the lymphocyte gate identifies an aberrant CD5-positive, CD10-positive, CD19-negative T-cell population (brown), distinct from the normal CD10-negative T cells. A separate small CD19-positive B-cell population (green) is highlighted on the light-chain plots, reported as clonal; the degree of light-chain restriction is difficult to judge at this figure's resolution. CD10 co-expression on T cells indicates a T follicular helper phenotype and is consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma, with a concurrent small B-cell clone, a known association in AITL.

ddx.dx: Reactive TFH cells in follicular hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Reactive TFH cells are few and retain bright surface CD3 and normal pan-T antigen intensity, without an expanded discrete CD10+ T-cell cluster.

ddx.dx: Follicular lymphoma or other CD10+ B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: The CD10+ population here is CD19-negative and CD5-positive, i.e., T-lineage, whereas FL cells are CD19+/CD20+.
T-LBL can be CD10+ but expresses TdT/CD34/CD1a and often lacks surface CD3.

60968.recognize_zh: 周邊血淋巴球細胞質內有數個清楚的小圓形空泡（A–C），骨髓抹片見細胞質充滿均勻細小空泡的泡沫狀巨噬細胞（D 箭頭），腹部 X 光則有雙側腎上腺鈣化（E 箭頭），三者合併指向 Wolman 病／膽固醇酯貯積症。
features: Panels A-C (PB): small lymphocytes with 1-7 discrete, sharply punched-out round cytoplasmic vacuoles
Panel D (BM aspirate): large macrophages with abundant cytoplasm distended by numerous uniform small clear vacuoles (foamy appearance), arrows
One foamy macrophage contains phagocytosed nuclear material/larger vacuoles; surrounding normal granulocytic and erythroid precursors
Panel E (abdominal radiograph): bilateral punctate adrenal calcifications above the kidneys (arrows)
60968.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows lymphocytes containing several discrete, round, clear cytoplasmic vacuoles. The bone marrow aspirate contains numerous large foamy macrophages whose cytoplasm is filled with uniform small vacuoles, amid otherwise maturing hematopoietic elements. An abdominal radiograph demonstrates bilateral adrenal calcification. The combination of vacuolated lymphocytes, foamy marrow macrophages and adrenal calcification is consistent with lysosomal acid lipase deficiency (Wolman disease/cholesteryl ester storage disease); lipid stains (oil red O) and enzyme assay confirm the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Also has foamy macrophages and vacuolated lymphocytes (type A), but lacks adrenal calcification and shows sphingomyelinase deficiency; sea-blue histiocytes may be present.
Foamy and sea-blue histiocytes are present but lymphocyte vacuolation is characteristically absent.
Gaucher cells have wrinkled tissue-paper (crumpled silk) cytoplasm rather than uniform clear vacuoles, and lymphocytes are not vacuolated.

ddx.dx: Mucopolysaccharidoses / GM1 gangliosidosis type 1 / Batten disease
ddx.vs: Vacuolated lymphocytes occur, but with Alder-Reilly granulation or specific inclusions, neurologic features and no adrenal calcification.

60904.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中正常造血被纖維化病灶取代，梭形纖維母細胞與膠原間夾雜小淋巴球、組織球、少數嗜酸性球與較大、核淡染的細胞，形成混合性發炎細胞浸潤；典型 Reed-Sternberg 細胞在此視野中不易確認，須以 CD30、CD15、PAX5 免疫染色標示腫瘤細胞。
features: Complete replacement of hematopoietic marrow in this field by a fibrotic lesion
Spindled fibroblasts in a pale eosinophilic collagenous/edematous stroma with a vaguely storiform-streaming pattern
Mixed inflammatory infiltrate of small lymphocytes, histiocytes and occasional eosinophils
Scattered larger cells with vesicular nuclei; diagnostic Reed-Sternberg cells are not clearly identified at this magnification
No normal trilineage hematopoiesis or fat within the lesion
60904.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a focal lesion that replaces normal hematopoietic elements and is composed of fibrous stroma with spindled fibroblasts and a mixed inflammatory infiltrate of small lymphocytes, histiocytes and occasional eosinophils. Scattered larger cells with vesicular nuclei are present, although unequivocal Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are not clearly identified at this magnification. In a patient with classical Hodgkin lymphoma, the fibrotic mixed-cell lesion is consistent with marrow involvement; immunostains for CD30, CD15, PAX5 (weak) and CD45 are recommended to highlight the neoplastic cells.

ddx.vs: Reactive fibrosis lacks CD30/CD15-positive Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells within the inflammatory background.
PTCL shows cytologically atypical T cells with aberrant antigen loss and clonal TR rearrangement rather than rare large CD30/CD15-positive, CD45-negative cells.
Its scattered large cells are strongly CD20/CD45 positive and CD15/CD30 negative, unlike HRS cells.
PMF shows diffuse fibrosis with clustered atypical megakaryocytes and osteosclerosis rather than a focal mixed inflammatory lesion.

60840.recognize_zh: 右側為充滿核碎片（karyorrhectic debris）與嗜中性球殘骸的壞死區，左側由胞核細長、呈腎形或拖鞋形的類上皮組織球（epithelioid histiocytes）環繞，構成壞死性肉芽腫性淋巴結炎。
features: Central zone of necrosis with abundant karyorrhectic nuclear dust, degenerating neutrophils and granular eosinophilic-to-basophilic debris (suppurative quality)
Surrounding palisade of epithelioid histiocytes with elongated, bean- or slipper-shaped vesicular nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Interspersed small lymphocytes in the outer zone
Fibrinoid/eosinophilic amorphous material at the interface between histiocytes and necrosis
No multinucleated giant cells or organisms identifiable at this magnification
60840.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a necrotizing granuloma. The necrotic center contains abundant karyorrhectic debris and degenerating neutrophils, giving a suppurative appearance, and is bordered by a rim of epithelioid histiocytes with elongated vesicular nuclei and pale cytoplasm, with scattered lymphocytes peripherally. Organisms are not identified on H&E at this magnification. Findings are consistent with necrotizing (suppurative) granulomatous lymphadenitis; special stains for acid-fast bacilli and fungi, cultures and serology (e.g., Bartonella) are recommended.

ddx.vs: Kikuchi necrosis is rich in karyorrhexis and crescentic histiocytes and plasmacytoid dendritic cells but characteristically lacks neutrophils and well-formed epithelioid granulomas.
Tuberculosis usually shows caseous necrosis with fewer neutrophils, Langhans giant cells and AFB-positive organisms, while stellate suppurative granulomas favor cat-scratch disease or tularemia.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma with necrosis (e.g., classic Hodgkin lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma shows atypical large cells (Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells, CD30+/CD15+) at the edge of necrosis rather than a pure epithelioid histiocytic rim.

60776.recognize_zh: 淋巴結中大量小型淋巴球為 HHV8/LANA 陰性（藍色），而沿竇道或血管內聚集的大型多形性腫瘤細胞呈強的棕色核染色，部分為顆粒點狀（speckled），這種分布與染色模式提示體腔外原發性積液淋巴瘤。
features: Background of small lymphocytes negative for HHV8/LANA
Clusters and cords of large pleomorphic tumor cells with strong nuclear LANA staining in a channel-like, sinusoidal/intravascular distribution
Nuclear staining is dense to coarsely granular/speckled
Occasional very large multinucleated or bizarre positive cells
Scattered single positive cells in the surrounding lymphoid tissue
60776.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for HHV8 latency-associated nuclear antigen (LANA) in a lymph node shows clusters and cords of large pleomorphic tumor cells with strong, dense to speckled nuclear staining arranged in a sinusoidal or intravascular distribution. The background small lymphocytes are negative, and rare single positive cells infiltrate the adjacent parenchyma. In combination with EBER positivity and the H&E morphology, findings are consistent with extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma with HHV8 and EBV co-infection.

ddx.vs: Also shows a sinusoidal pattern of pleomorphic large cells, but these are strongly CD30+ with T-cell or null phenotype and HHV8/LANA negative.

ddx.dx: HHV8-positive multicentric Castleman disease with microlymphomas
ddx.vs: LANA-positive plasmablasts are scattered in the mantle zones around regressed follicles and express IgM lambda, rather than forming sinusoidal sheets of pleomorphic cells.
Shows similar immunoblastic/plasmablastic cells with CD138 and often EBER positivity, but is HHV8/LANA negative.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma in sinuses
ddx.vs: Sinusoidal tumor cells express cytokeratin or S100/SOX10 and are HHV8 negative.

60584.recognize_zh: 大體標本可見小腸壁內白色、魚肉狀的腫瘤塊；H&E 為一致性的中等大小淋巴球瀰漫成片，細胞形態單調、核圓深染，符合單形性上皮向性腸道 T 細胞淋巴瘤（原 EATL type II）。
features: Gross: resected bowel segment with a white-tan, fleshy, homogeneous transmural mass
Diffuse sheets of monomorphic small to medium-sized lymphoid cells
Round, hyperchromatic nuclei with rim of pale/clear cytoplasm
Little pleomorphism and no conspicuous inflammatory background or necrosis in this field
60584.describe_en: Gross photograph shows a resected segment of intestine containing a large, white-tan, fleshy, homogeneous mass expanding the bowel wall. Histologic section shows diffuse sheets of monomorphic small-to-medium-sized lymphoid cells with round hyperchromatic nuclei and a rim of pale cytoplasm, without significant pleomorphism or mixed inflammatory infiltrate. Epitheliotropism cannot be assessed in this field. With appropriate immunophenotype (typically CD3+, CD8+, CD56+, often TCR gamma-delta or alpha-beta), findings are consistent with monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma (formerly EATL type II).

ddx.vs: EATL is pleomorphic with large anaplastic cells, a rich inflammatory background, CD56 negativity and association with celiac disease.
Shows angiocentric growth with necrosis and is EBER positive, whereas MEITL is EBV negative.

ddx.dx: Burkitt or other B-cell lymphoma of the bowel
ddx.vs: Burkitt has a starry-sky pattern and B-cell markers with MYC rearrangement; MEITL is CD3+ CD20- with no starry sky.

ddx.dx: Indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract
ddx.vs: Involves mucosa superficially with small cells and low Ki-67 without forming a destructive transmural mass.

60648.recognize_zh: A 圖周邊血可見數個中小型不典型淋巴樣細胞，核形不規則、有凹陷或分葉（部分呈花瓣狀），另可見吞噬細胞碎屑的大細胞；B 圖 ALK IHC 在多個中小型細胞呈核與胞質陽性，支持 ALK 陽性間變性大細胞淋巴瘤（ALCL）小細胞型的白血化期。
features: Small to medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, indented to lobulated ('flower-like') nuclei
Moderately condensed chromatin and a thin rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm; large hallmark cells are not evident
Occasional large cell with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing debris (histiocyte-like)
ALK immunostain (panel B) shows nuclear and cytoplasmic positivity in a subset of small-to-medium cells
Many admixed ALK-negative background cells, indicating the neoplastic cells are a minority population
60648.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (panel A) shows scattered small to medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, indented, and lobulated nuclei and scant basophilic cytoplasm, together with an occasional large cell with vacuolated cytoplasm. Large pleomorphic hallmark cells are not prominent at this magnification. Immunohistochemistry for ALK (panel B) on a cytologic preparation shows nuclear and cytoplasmic staining in a subset of small and medium-sized cells, a pattern typical of the NPM1::ALK fusion. Findings are consistent with the small-cell variant of ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma in leukemic phase.

ddx.vs: ATLL shows polylobated 'flower cells' too, but is HTLV-1 associated and ALK negative, with typically CD25-positive, CD30-variable cells.
T-PLL cells have a single prominent nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, and are TCL1-positive and ALK/CD30 negative.
Sézary cells have cerebriform, grooved nuclei with a CD4+/CD7−/CD26− phenotype and lack ALK expression.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm hugging red cells and a polyclonal phenotype without ALK or strong CD30 staining.

60712.recognize_zh: 雙大腿有廣泛紅褐色斑丘疹，周邊血可見核呈多葉花瓣狀、染色質濃縮的「花細胞」（flower cell），皮膚切片真皮有密集淋巴球浸潤，T 細胞標記陽性，綜合符合成人 T 細胞白血病／淋巴瘤（ATLL）。
features: Clinical photo (A): widespread erythematous to violaceous confluent papules and macules over both thighs
Peripheral blood (B): medium-sized lymphoid cell with a convoluted, multilobated flower-like nucleus, condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Skin H&E (C, first panel): dense band-like dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphoid cells beneath an acanthotic epidermis
Skin IHC (C): diffuse staining of the dermal infiltrate with the first two markers and only scattered positive cells with the last marker (labels not legible at this resolution)
Background blood with normal red cells and platelets
60712.describe_en: The clinical photograph shows extensive erythematous papular eruption over the thighs. The peripheral blood smear contains an atypical lymphoid cell with a markedly convoluted, multilobated 'flower' nucleus and condensed chromatin. Skin biopsy demonstrates a dense dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes; immunohistochemical stains (labels not legible in this image) diffusely highlight the infiltrate with two markers while a third marks only scattered cells, compatible with a CD4-predominant T-cell phenotype. Findings are consistent with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma with cutaneous involvement; HTLV-1 serology/proviral integration and CD25 expression should be confirmed.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei rather than polylobated flower nuclei, are HTLV-1 negative and typically CD25 negative or dim.
T-PLL cells have a prominent nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs with TCL1 overexpression, and lack HTLV-1.
Reactive lymphocytes lack multilobated nuclei and skin infiltrates are polymorphous with eosinophils rather than monotonous atypical T cells.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS involving skin
ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS lacks HTLV-1 clonal integration and the characteristic circulating flower cells.

60712.stain: Clinical photo; Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC (T-cell panel)
captions: Clinical photo: widespread erythematous papular rash on thighs
Peripheral blood: flower cell with multilobated nucleus
Skin biopsy H&E and IHC panel: dense dermal atypical T-cell infiltrate

60520.recognize_zh: 大量原始細胞背景中，可見多個巨核細胞核呈分離的圓形小核（separated/disjointed nuclei）或單葉圓核，體積偏小；芽細胞增加合併這種巨核細胞發育異常，應聯想 AML with inv(3)/t(3;3)。
features: Numerous medium to large blasts with fine chromatin, nucleoli and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Several megakaryocytes with multiple separate round nuclear lobes (disjointed/widely separated nuclei)
Megakaryocytes with single round non-lobated nuclei and moderate pale granular cytoplasm
Megakaryocytes are relatively small compared with normal mature forms
Scattered small lymphocytes and occasional maturing granulocytes
60520.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular with a predominance of medium to large blasts showing fine chromatin, nucleoli and scant basophilic cytoplasm. Multiple megakaryocytes are dysplastic, with widely separated round nuclear lobes or single non-lobated round nuclei in relatively small cells. Residual maturing granulocytes are sparse. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with prominent megakaryocytic dysplasia, a pattern suggestive of AML with inv(3)(q21.3q26.2)/t(3;3) (GATA2::MECOM); confirmation requires cytogenetics or MECOM FISH.

ddx.vs: Multilineage dysplasia is shared, so the distinction rests on demonstrating a 3q26 MECOM rearrangement by karyotype or FISH.
MDS-EB has a similar megakaryocytic dysplasia but fewer blasts (<20% in WHO 2016) than the blast-predominant field seen here.
In AMKL the blasts themselves are megakaryoblasts (CD41/CD61+ with blebs) rather than non-megakaryocytic blasts accompanied by dysplastic mature megakaryocytes.

60456.recognize_zh: 低倍 cyclin D1 染色，淋巴組織大範圍呈細胞核棕色陽性，其中多個圓形結節染色更深，結節之間為陰性的纖維血管間隔；B 細胞淋巴瘤出現瀰漫性 cyclin D1 核陽性，是被套細胞淋巴瘤的關鍵線索。
features: Low-power view with extensive nuclear cyclin D1 positivity across the lymphoid infiltrate
Vaguely nodular pattern with rounded nodules showing denser staining
Negative fibrovascular band traversing the center of the field
Capsule/perinodal tissue at upper left largely negative
Individual cytology not assessable at this magnification
60456.describe_en: Low-power cyclin D1 immunostain shows diffuse nuclear positivity throughout the lymphoid infiltrate, with a vaguely nodular pattern in which rounded nodules stain more densely. A central fibrovascular band and the capsular region are negative. Cytologic detail cannot be evaluated at this power. Findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma, with a nodular to diffuse growth pattern.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia or plasma cell myeloma
ddx.vs: These can express weak cyclin D1, but their morphology, CD5 negativity, and other markers (annexin A1, CD138) differ from a small CD5-positive B-cell lymphoma.
CLL/SLL is cyclin D1 negative except for weak staining in proliferation centers and is LEF1 and CD23 positive.
Morphology is identical, but cyclin D1 is negative and SOX11 positivity with CCND2 rearrangement confirms the diagnosis.

60392.recognize_zh: 四格胸水抹片中，大量紅血球背景（血性胸水）裡散布大型漿細胞樣細胞：核偏位、細胞質深嗜鹼性並有核旁淡染區（hof）與細小空泡，部分細胞核大、染色質較細、體積明顯大於成熟漿細胞，右下格另見雙核／核分裂樣細胞；骨髓瘤病史加上這些不成熟漿母細胞，支持骨髓瘤性（plasmablastic）胸水。
features: Composite of four fields from a bloody pleural effusion smear with dense red cell background
Large plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hof
Immature (plasmablastic) features: large nuclei with relatively fine/dispersed chromatin, high N:C ratio in some cells; nucleoli not well resolved at this resolution
Small clear cytoplasmic vacuoles along the cell margins in several cells
Pleomorphism with a binucleate/multilobated cell and a possible mitotic figure (lower right panel); scattered small lymphocytes and a neutrophil
60392.describe_en: Cytospin/smear of pleural fluid shows a markedly bloody background with numerous atypical plasma cells, illustrated in four fields. The cells are large, with eccentric nuclei, abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, perinuclear hofs and fine peripheral vacuoles; many have relatively dispersed chromatin and a high N:C ratio, consistent with plasmablastic morphology. Pleomorphic forms, a binucleate cell and a probable mitotic figure are present, whereas mesothelial cells and reactive inflammatory cells are sparse; nucleoli are not well resolved at this image resolution. In a patient with a history of multiple myeloma, and with flow cytometric confirmation of a clonal plasma cell population, findings are consistent with myelomatous (plasmablastic) pleural effusion.

ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells have central round nuclei, dense two-tone cytoplasm with a peripheral lacy brush border and form 'windows' between cells, lacking the eccentric nucleus and perinuclear hof of plasma cells; calretinin/CD138 separate them.

Plasmablastic lymphoma has similar cytology but usually arises in HIV/immunosuppressed patients without a myeloma history, lacks serum paraprotein-related bone disease and is often EBER-positive and MYC-rearranged.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis in effusion (e.g., tuberculosis, rheumatoid pleuritis)
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small, mature and polytypic, mixed with lymphocytes, not large pleomorphic plasmablasts with mitoses and light-chain restriction.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive three-dimensional clusters with nuclear molding and keratin positivity, whereas myeloma cells are discohesive, CD138-positive and light-chain restricted.

60136.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD61 免疫染色中，大量棕色陽性巨核細胞散佈並局部成群，大小不一，許多細胞偏小、核分葉少，另見陽性小碎片（血小板），顯示巨核細胞增生且型態異常。
features: Increased CD61-positive megakaryocytes scattered and in small loose clusters
Marked size variation, including many small megakaryocytes with hypolobated nuclei
Strong membranous/cytoplasmic brown staining; nuclei visible as pale unstained areas
Numerous small CD61-positive fragments consistent with platelets
Background hypercellular marrow with CD61-negative hematopoietic cells
60136.describe_en: CD61 immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow trephine highlights increased megakaryocytes distributed singly and in small loose clusters within a hypercellular background. The megakaryocytes vary in size, and many are small with hypolobated nuclei. Scattered CD61-positive platelet fragments are present. In this patient with a PDGFRA-rearranged myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm, the stain documents megakaryocytic hyperplasia with atypia; eosinophilia and mast cell findings on H&E and genetics establish the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Classic MPNs show large hyperlobated (ET) or bulbous hyperchromatic (PMF) megakaryocytes in tight clusters and carry JAK2/CALR/MPL rather than PDGFRA fusion.

ddx.dx: Systemic mastocytosis with associated myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: Dense compact aggregates of spindle mast cells positive for tryptase, CD117 and CD25 with KIT D816V favor SM, whereas FIP1L1-PDGFRA is detected by FISH/RT-PCR here.
MDS shows cytopenias with small monolobated micromegakaryocytes but lacks marked eosinophilia and PDGFRA rearrangement.

60072.recognize_zh: 這是骨髓流式圖（含 CD71）：正常紅血球系前驅細胞應出現在 CD45 陰性、低 SSC、CD71 強陽性的位置，但 CD45 對 SSC 與 CD45 對 CD71 圖中都看不到這群細胞，CD71 幾乎全為陰性到弱陽性；畫面以顆粒球（淺藍）占多數，印證 Diamond-Blackfan anemia 的紅血球系缺乏。
features: FSC vs SSC and CD45 vs SSC: dominant granulocytic population (light blue, high SSC, CD45 moderate), with monocytes (green) and lymphocytes (red/dark blue, low SSC, CD45 bright)
No CD45-negative, low-SSC event cluster where nucleated erythroid precursors normally reside
CD71 vs CD45: essentially all events CD71 negative to dim; no CD71-bright CD45-negative erythroid population
CD33 vs HLA-DR and CD33 vs CD45: CD33+ granulocytes (HLA-DR negative) and CD33 bright HLA-DR+ monocytes; CD33-negative lymphocytes
No discrete CD45-dim blast population apparent
60072.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of bone marrow displays FSC/SSC, CD45/SSC, CD33/HLA-DR, CD45/CD71, CD33/CD45, and HLA-DR/CD45 plots. The events are dominated by maturing granulocytes (CD33 positive, HLA-DR negative, high side scatter), with smaller populations of monocytes (bright CD33, HLA-DR positive) and CD45-bright lymphocytes. There is no CD45-negative, low side-scatter population and no CD71-bright events, indicating an absence of nucleated erythroid precursors, and no discrete CD45-dim blast population is evident. These findings support marked erythroid hypoplasia with myeloid predominance, consistent with the morphologic impression of Diamond-Blackfan anemia; note that lysis protocols and hemodilution can reduce erythroid events, so correlation with the aspirate is required.

ddx.dx: Pre-analytic loss of erythroid precursors (RBC lysis, hemodilution)
ddx.vs: Ammonium chloride lysis and peripheral blood contamination can deplete nucleated red cells artifactually; the aspirate morphology must confirm true erythroid hypoplasia.

ddx.dx: Transient erythroblastopenia of childhood or parvovirus B19 aplasia
ddx.vs: Produce the same flow pattern; distinguished clinically and by B19 PCR, HbF, eADA, and ribosomal protein gene testing.
Would show a discrete CD45-dim, low side-scatter blast population, which is not present here.

60008.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中唯一的白血球是一顆中型母細胞：染色質細緻、核質比高、只有少量藍色細胞質且無 Auer 小體；背景紅血球有數個淚滴狀細胞、血小板稀少，符合白血球低下伴隨循環母細胞。
features: Solitary medium-sized circulating blast as the only leukocyte in the field
High N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli not well seen
No Auer rods
Red cells show mild poikilocytosis with teardrop forms; platelets decreased
60008.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single circulating blast with a high nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, and a thin rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm, without Auer rods. No neutrophils are present in the field, consistent with the reported neutropenia. Red cells show mild poikilocytosis with scattered teardrop cells, and platelets appear decreased. Findings indicate circulating blasts with cytopenias; blast lineage requires flow cytometry, and in this case the findings support acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm scalloping around red cells and coarser chromatin than this blast.
Lymphoblasts are morphologically indistinguishable without Auer rods, requiring MPO cytochemistry or flow cytometry.
Myelofibrosis shows numerous teardrop cells with nucleated red cells and immature granulocytes, and marrow fibrosis rather than 20% or more blasts.

28904.recognize_zh: 骨病灶的抹片與切片可見胞質淡染、核呈卵圓或腎形有溝的組織球成群，夾雜多核巨細胞；免疫染色膜狀陽性（CD1a 類）與核/胞質陽性（S100 類），加上「口渴」（尿崩症）的臨床線索，指向 Langerhans cell histiocytosis。
features: Aspirate/touch smear with loose clusters of medium-to-large histiocytoid cells with oval, folded or reniform nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate pale cytoplasm, admixed with small lymphocytes (panel A)
Section between bony trabeculae showing a cellular infiltrate of histiocytes with scattered multinucleated giant cells and mixed inflammatory cells (panel C)
Strong membranous and cytoplasmic immunostaining of the lesional histiocytes (panel B; likely CD1a or langerin)
Nuclear and cytoplasmic immunostaining of many lesional cells (panel D; pattern typical of S100)
Adjacent fibrous stroma and bone negative for both markers
28904.describe_en: Smear preparation from the lesion shows loosely cohesive histiocytoid cells with oval to reniform, focally grooved nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate amounts of pale cytoplasm, admixed with lymphocytes. The corresponding biopsy shows a histiocytic infiltrate filling the intertrabecular space with scattered multinucleated giant cells and mixed inflammatory cells. Immunohistochemistry demonstrates strong membranous staining of the lesional cells (consistent with CD1a/langerin) and nuclear-cytoplasmic staining consistent with S100. In a child presenting with polydipsia suggestive of central diabetes insipidus, findings are consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis.

ddx.vs: RDD histiocytes are S100-positive but CD1a-negative with large round nuclei and emperipolesis rather than grooved nuclei.
ECD shows foamy CD68+/CD163+ histiocytes with Touton cells that are CD1a-negative, typically with symmetric long-bone sclerosis.
Infection shows neutrophils, necrosis and reactive macrophages without CD1a/langerin-positive cells.

ddx.dx: Germinoma or other suprasellar lesion causing diabetes insipidus
ddx.vs: Germinoma contains large polygonal cells with clear cytoplasm expressing OCT3/4 and PLAP with a lymphocytic background, not CD1a-positive histiocytes.

28648.recognize_zh: AML 化療中病人皮膚出現中央藍紫色壞死、外圍紅暈的結節（類 ecthyma 病灶），切片可見血管腔內充滿淡染的真菌菌絲並阻塞血管（箭頭），代表血管侵襲性黴菌感染，臨床脈絡下符合播散性鐮刀菌病（fusariosis）。
features: Clinical photograph of a round skin lesion with a central blue-violaceous to necrotic center and a surrounding erythematous rim (panel A)
Dermal/subcutaneous vessel whose lumen is occluded by pale fibrinous material containing numerous fungal hyphae (arrow, panel B)
Thickened vessel wall with sparse inflammatory cells, consistent with angioinvasion and thrombosis
Surrounding collagen/skeletal muscle bundles without a prominent neutrophilic infiltrate, compatible with neutropenia
Hyphal septation and branching angle cannot be reliably assessed at this magnification
28648.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows a well-circumscribed cutaneous nodule with a dusky blue-violaceous necrotic center and an erythematous halo. The skin biopsy shows a deep vessel with luminal thrombosis containing abundant pale-staining fungal hyphae, with angioinvasion and a paucity of surrounding inflammation. Speciation of the hyphae is not possible on H&E alone because Fusarium, Aspergillus and other hyalohyphomycetes appear similar; culture or molecular identification is required. In a neutropenic patient undergoing AML induction, findings are consistent with angioinvasive disseminated mould infection, compatible with fusariosis.

ddx.vs: Aspergillus also forms narrow septate acute-angle branching angioinvasive hyphae, so separation from Fusarium requires culture (banana-shaped macroconidia) or PCR, though positive blood cultures favor Fusarium.
Mucorales hyphae are broad, ribbon-like and pauciseptate with right-angle branching, unlike the narrow septate hyphae of Fusarium.
Ecthyma gangrenosum shows gram-negative bacilli cuffing vessels without fungal hyphae on GMS/PAS stains.
Leukemia cutis shows a dermal infiltrate of blasts rather than intravascular fungal elements and necrosis.

22440.recognize_zh: 同一病人骨髓 2002 與 2013 年比較：2002 年抹片與切片細胞量尚可，含紅血球系前驅細胞群；2013 年抹片脂肪滴增多，切片（D）幾乎只剩脂肪與骨小樑，顯示 PNH 病程中轉變為骨髓低增生／再生不良。
features: Panel A (2002 aspirate): cellular particle with clusters of erythroid precursors and mixed myeloid cells
Panel B (2013 aspirate): more fat droplets with fewer hematopoietic cells, relative predominance of lymphocytes and erythroid cells
Panel C (2002 biopsy): moderately cellular marrow with preserved hematopoietic tissue between fat spaces
Panel D (2013 biopsy): markedly hypocellular marrow composed mostly of fat with bony trabeculae and scant residual hematopoiesis
No infiltrate of blasts or foreign cells identified at these magnifications
22440.describe_en: Serial bone marrow aspirates and trephine biopsies are shown. The 2002 aspirate and biopsy show preserved cellularity with erythroid precursor clusters and trilineage hematopoiesis. The 2013 aspirate contains more fat and fewer hematopoietic elements, and the corresponding biopsy is markedly hypocellular, consisting predominantly of adipose tissue between bony trabeculae with only scant residual hematopoiesis. No blast increase or infiltrative process is seen at this magnification. In a patient with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria, findings are consistent with progression to marrow hypoplasia (aplastic anemia/PNH overlap); the PNH clone itself must be documented by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Hypocellular MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes or increased CD34-positive blasts and clonal cytogenetic abnormalities, which are not evident here.

ddx.dx: Idiopathic aplastic anemia without a PNH clone
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so FLAER/CD24 or CD157 flow cytometry is needed to detect a GPI-deficient clone.
Inherited syndromes (e.g., Fanconi anemia, telomere biology disorders) require chromosome breakage or telomere length testing rather than morphology.
A true hypocellular marrow is uniformly hypocellular over an adequate core length, not just at the subcortical edge.

21544.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有一團團彼此黏聚的大型腫瘤細胞，細胞質內散布許多邊界清楚的小圓形空泡，核圓、細胞邊界互相擠壓；不同於分散的造血細胞，提示非造血腫瘤轉移（年輕成人的腺泡狀橫紋肌肉瘤）。
features: Cohesive clusters of large tumor cells with molded cell borders
Round nuclei with finely granular chromatin filling most of the cell (high N:C ratio)
Numerous small, sharply punched-out cytoplasmic vacuoles, often at the cell periphery
Occasional smaller, darker cells within clusters
Background erythrocytes only; atypical staining hue (yellow-orange background) limits color assessment
21544.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows cohesive clusters of large atypical cells with round nuclei, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and molded borders, many containing numerous small, sharply defined cytoplasmic vacuoles. Normal hematopoietic elements are not prominent in this field. The unusual background coloration limits assessment of chromatin and cytoplasmic basophilia. Findings are consistent with marrow infiltration by a non-hematopoietic small round cell tumor, in this case metastatic alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma; confirmation requires desmin and myogenin immunostaining and FOXO1 rearrangement studies.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells show similar vacuoles but are discohesive, deeply basophilic and CD20/CD10-positive with MYC rearrangement.
Ewing sarcoma also forms vacuolated clusters (glycogen), so CD99/NKX2-2 staining and EWSR1 rearrangement, with myogenin negativity, separate it.
Neuroblastoma occurs in young children and forms Homer-Wright rosettes with fibrillary neuropil.
Leukemic blasts are discohesive and express CD45 with myeloid or lymphoid markers.

20456.recognize_zh: 周邊血中可見多顆嗜酸性球、一顆深色顆粒的嗜鹼性球、左移的未成熟顆粒球與一顆細胞質嗜鹼性的大型母細胞樣細胞，呈現伴嗜酸性球增多的骨髓增生性表現；確診 PCM1::JAK2 需靠 t(8;9)(p22;p24) 細胞遺傳學。
features: Eosinophilia with mature bilobed eosinophils containing coarse orange-red granules
Basophil with dense, dark purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus (panel C)
Left-shifted granulocytes including bands and a myelocyte/metamyelocyte with folded nuclei
Occasional large immature cell with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, and deeply basophilic cytoplasm (panels A and B)
Background red cells largely normocytic without obvious dysplastic or fragmented forms
20456.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mixed myeloid picture with increased eosinophils, a basophil, and left-shifted granulocytic precursors including bands and a myelocyte-stage cell. Scattered large immature cells with high N:C ratios, fine chromatin, and basophilic cytoplasm are also present. Red cells show no striking abnormality. These findings indicate a myeloproliferative process with eosinophilia and basophilia but are not specific; they are suggestive of a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase gene fusion, and the reported t(8;9)(p22;p24) confirms PCM1::JAK2.

ddx.vs: CML shows a similar left shift with basophilia and eosinophilia, and is separated by BCR::ABL1 detection rather than by morphology.
PDGFRA cases are typically dominated by eosinophils with increased atypical mast cells and are identified by FIP1L1::PDGFRA (CHIC2 deletion FISH), not a 9p24 JAK2 break.
FGFR1 cases frequently present with T-lymphoblastic lymphoma or blast transformation and carry 8p11 rearrangements, whereas PCM1::JAK2 involves 8p22 and 9p24.
Reactive eosinophilia (parasites, allergy, drugs) lacks basophilia, circulating myeloid precursors, and a clonal cytogenetic abnormality.

19432.recognize_zh: 臨床照片可見大腿與小腿皮膚大片壞死性潰瘍及周邊皮下結節（A、E 箭頭），PET/CT 顯示鼻腔、脾臟與皮下病灶 FDG 高攝取（B–E），呈現 NK/T 細胞淋巴瘤合併皮膚與全身侵犯的臨床樣貌；這不是顯微鏡圖，確診仍需組織切片。
features: Panel A: large necrotic ulcer with a rolled erythematous border and surrounding induration on the thigh, plus additional subcutaneous nodules (arrows), and a separate ulcer on the lower leg
Panel B: PET/CT with intense FDG uptake in the nasal cavity
Panel C: axial chest PET/CT with intense uptake in a left upper abdominal organ (spleen) and small measured nodes
Panel D: coronal PET/CT with markedly FDG-avid enlarged spleen
Panel E: subtle subcutaneous nodule of the lower leg (arrow) with focal FDG uptake on PET
19432.describe_en: This composite of clinical photographs and PET/CT images is not morphologic. It shows necrotic ulcerated skin lesions and subcutaneous nodules on the lower limbs, with FDG-avid disease in the nasal cavity, spleen, and subcutaneous tissue of the leg, indicating extranasal and disseminated involvement. These appearances are suggestive of extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma with cutaneous and systemic spread, but they are not specific; biopsy of a lesion showing an angiocentric, necrotizing infiltrate of atypical cells positive for cytoplasmic CD3, CD56, cytotoxic granule proteins, and EBER is required for diagnosis, and plasma EBV DNA is useful for monitoring.

ddx.vs: It also forms ulcerated nodules on the extremities but lacks EBV (EBER negative) and expresses TCR gamma-delta.
SPTCL forms subcutaneous nodules that rarely ulcerate, with rimming of adipocytes by alpha-beta CD8+ cells that are EBER and CD56 negative.

ddx.dx: Pyoderma gangrenosum or ecthyma from infection
ddx.vs: These produce similar necrotic ulcers but biopsy shows neutrophilic inflammation or organisms without an atypical EBV-positive cytotoxic lymphoid infiltrate or nasal and splenic FDG-avid disease.

18664.recognize_zh: 九格周邊血拼圖整理急性白血病的芽細胞（blasts）：共同特徵為細胞大、核質比高、染色質細緻、可見核仁；有些胞質深藍帶小泡突起（blebs），有些含細小嗜天青顆粒或核折疊，另有核質比極高、胞質極少的小型芽細胞，提示不同系別。
features: A, F, I: low-power fields with increased circulating blasts among red cells
B, D: blasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and irregular cytoplasmic projections/blebs
C, G: large blasts with fine open chromatin, visible nucleoli, and moderate blue cytoplasm; G shows fine azurophilic granules and vacuoles
E: blast with folded/indented nucleus and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm suggesting monocytic lineage, beside a smaller mononuclear cell
H: blast with very high N:C ratio, round nucleus, and scant cytoplasm suggesting lymphoblast morphology
18664.describe_en: This composite of peripheral blood smears illustrates circulating blasts in acute leukemia and precursor neoplasms. Low-power panels show numerous blasts, and high-power panels show large cells with high N:C ratio, fine open chromatin, and nucleoli. Features that hint at lineage include cytoplasmic blebs with deep basophilia (possible megakaryoblastic or erythroid lineage), fine azurophilic granules (myeloid), folded nuclei with gray-blue cytoplasm (monocytic), and small cells with scant agranular cytoplasm (lymphoblastic). Morphology alone is insufficient to assign lineage; flow cytometry, cytochemistry (MPO, nonspecific esterase), and genetic studies are required, and individual panel diagnoses are not labeled in the image.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have condensed chromatin and abundant cytoplasm that scallops around red cells, lacking the fine blastic chromatin and nucleoli of blasts.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of high-grade lymphoma (e.g., Burkitt)
ddx.vs: Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm and are TdT negative with surface light chain and MYC rearrangement, whereas lymphoblasts are TdT positive.

ddx.dx: Circulating promonocytes versus monoblasts in CMML
ddx.vs: Blast equivalents are counted together, and the 20% threshold separates AML from CMML, so careful enumeration rather than qualitative recognition is needed.

15144.recognize_zh: 四格骨髓免疫染色：CD20 陽性 B 細胞沿竇狀隙呈線狀、串珠狀排列，A 圖同時伴隨結節性聚集，B 圖則以單純竇內分布為主；CD3 陽性 T 細胞在 C 圖稀疏散在於竇內，D 圖則在擴張的竇內大量充填，這種竇內浸潤（intrasinusoidal）模式是脾臟淋巴瘤侵犯骨髓的線索。
features: A: CD20+ B cells forming a nodular aggregate plus linear intrasinusoidal cords (pattern typical of splenic marginal zone lymphoma)
B: CD20+ cells confined to sinusoids as linear strings between fat cells without nodules
C: scattered CD3+ T cells in subtle intrasinusoidal and interstitial distribution
D: extensive, dense intrasinusoidal CD3+ infiltrate filling dilated sinusoids of a hypercellular marrow (pattern typical of hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma)
Bony trabeculae (blue) and fat preserved; intrasinusoidal pattern often inconspicuous on H&E
15144.describe_en: Composite bone marrow core biopsies immunostained for CD20 (A, B) and CD3 (C, D) illustrate intrasinusoidal infiltration by splenic lymphomas. In A, CD20-positive B cells form a paratrabecular/interstitial nodule accompanied by linear intrasinusoidal cords, a combination typical of splenic marginal zone lymphoma. In B, CD20-positive cells are predominantly restricted to sinusoidal lumens as thin linear strings, as seen in splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma or hairy cell leukemia variant. In C, CD3-positive T cells are subtly distributed within sinusoids, while in D a dense intrasinusoidal CD3-positive infiltrate expands the sinusoids of a hypercellular marrow, a pattern characteristic of hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma. Exact entity assignment per panel requires the original legend and additional immunophenotyping (e.g., TCR gamma-delta, CD8, granzyme B for T-cell panels).

ddx.vs: CLL infiltrates marrow in nodular, interstitial or diffuse patterns with CD5/CD23 co-expression and rarely shows a predominantly intrasinusoidal pattern.
Classic HCL produces a diffuse interstitial spaced-out infiltrate with reticulin fibrosis and is annexin A1/BRAF V600E-positive, rather than purely linear intrasinusoidal cords.
T-LGL also shows intrasinusoidal CD8+/granzyme B+ linear arrays but with small interstitial clusters and a mature indolent phenotype, unlike the heavy sinusoidal filling of HSTL.
Occasional reactive intrasinusoidal lymphocytes are sparse, polyclonal and lack the continuous cord-like arrays of neoplastic infiltration.

15144.stain: IHC: CD20 (A, B); IHC: CD3 (C, D)
captions: A: CD20 showing nodular and intrasinusoidal B-cell infiltration
B: CD20 showing purely intrasinusoidal linear B-cell cords
C: CD3 showing subtle intrasinusoidal T cells
D: CD3 showing dense intrasinusoidal T-cell infiltration

12648.recognize_zh: 左圖周邊血液中可見一顆圓形、胞質滿布深紫色粗大顆粒的肥大細胞（mast cell）；右圖骨髓抹片則是成片的肥大細胞，部分呈紡錘形、雙葉核、顆粒減少，這種骨髓大量浸潤但血中只有少數的組合提示非白血性（aleukemic）肥大細胞白血病。
features: PB: single round medium-sized cell with cytoplasm packed with coarse dark purple metachromatic granules obscuring the nucleus (circulating mast cell)
BM aspirate: sheets of atypical mast cells replacing normal hematopoiesis
Atypical mast cells with oval to spindle shapes, eccentric or bilobed nuclei and variably hypogranular cytoplasm
Granules in marrow mast cells are reddish-purple and unevenly distributed, with degranulated areas
PB background shows normocytic red cells and a band neutrophil; no obvious leukocytosis in the field
12648.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a circulating mast cell with abundant coarse metachromatic granules adjacent to a band neutrophil; circulating mast cells are rare. The bone marrow aspirate shows sheets of atypical mast cells with oval to spindled morphology, bilobed or eccentric nuclei and partially hypogranular cytoplasm, effacing normal hematopoietic elements. Given that mast cells constitute at least 20% of marrow nucleated cells but fewer than 10% of circulating leukocytes, findings are consistent with the aleukemic variant of mast cell leukemia; KIT D816V testing, tryptase and CD25/CD2/CD30 immunophenotyping are recommended.

ddx.vs: Basophils have segmented nuclei with water-soluble granules overlying the nucleus and are tryptase-low, CD117-negative, whereas mast cells have round/oval nuclei, CD117 bright and tryptase strong.

ddx.dx: Systemic mastocytosis with an associated myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: SM-AMN shows a separate clonal myeloid component (e.g., CMML, AML) and marrow mast cells usually below 20% on aspirate, rather than a marrow dominated by atypical mast cells.
Abnormal promyelocytes have bilobed nuclei with Auer rods and strong MPO, whereas mast cells are MPO-negative and tryptase/CD117 positive with metachromatic granules.

3688.recognize_zh: 上臂/前臂皮膚上有一塊數公分大、紫紅色、邊緣暈開的平坦瘀斑（ecchymosis），周邊皮膚曬傷斑點多，下方近手肘處有褐色色素沉著，屬於皮下出血的臨床照片。
features: Single ill-defined violaceous flat ecchymosis several centimeters in size on the arm
Feathered, irregular margins with central darker purple area
Surrounding photodamaged skin with lentigines
Brownish discoloration near the elbow, possibly resolving bruise or hyperpigmentation
No petechiae or palpable lesions evident
3688.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the arm shows a single, flat, ill-defined violaceous ecchymosis measuring several centimeters, with feathered margins, on sun-damaged skin with scattered lentigines. A brownish discoloration near the elbow may represent a resolving bruise or post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation. No petechiae or palpable purpura are evident. Ecchymoses indicate subcutaneous bleeding; evaluation should include medication history (anticoagulants, antiplatelet agents, steroids), platelet count, PT, aPTT and, when indicated, factor assays.

ddx.vs: Occurs on sun-damaged forearms of the elderly with normal coagulation tests and is typically sharply demarcated.

ddx.dx: Acquired hemophilia A or other factor deficiency
ddx.vs: Large spontaneous ecchymoses with an isolated prolonged aPTT that fails to correct on mixing suggest a factor inhibitor.
Bleeding is usually petechial and mucocutaneous with a low platelet count rather than isolated ecchymoses.
Scurvy shows perifollicular hemorrhages, corkscrew hairs and gum bleeding in addition to ecchymoses.

2024.recognize_zh: 抹片中一片淡藍色細胞質連成的大型聚集，內含多顆偏小、形狀不規則的細胞核，符合成群的高雪細胞（Gaucher cells）；但本圖解析度有限，典型的「皺摺薄紙樣」細胞質紋路不甚清楚。
features: Large aggregate of cells with abundant pale blue cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Multiple small, eccentric, irregular to crushed nuclei within the aggregate
Cytoplasm appears finely textured; the characteristic striated 'crumpled tissue paper' pattern is not well resolved
Scattered clear vacuoles and linear stretched strands in the background
Few interspersed hematopoietic cells
2024.describe_en: Smear (probably bone marrow aspirate) shows a large aggregate of cells with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and indistinct borders, containing numerous small, eccentric, irregular nuclei, with scattered vacuoles and stretched crush artifact. The distinctive fibrillary, crumpled tissue paper texture of Gaucher cell cytoplasm is not clearly resolved at this resolution, so the morphology alone is only suggestive. In the proper clinical context the findings are consistent with clusters of Gaucher cells; confirmation by glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay or GBA1 genotyping is recommended.

ddx.vs: Morphologically indistinguishable; normal glucocerebrosidase activity and the underlying disease separate them.
Niemann-Pick cells have bubbly, vacuolated foamy cytoplasm rather than striated fibrillary cytoplasm.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules rather than diffuse pale striated cytoplasm.
Tumor clusters show nuclear pleomorphism, nucleoli and molding rather than small bland eccentric nuclei in abundant cytoplasm.

2088.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結切片中，淡粉紅色、細胞質豐富的腫瘤細胞巢佔據被膜下竇（subcapsular sinus）並向內取代實質，將殘存的深藍色淋巴組織與濾泡擠在中間，是轉移性癌（metastatic carcinoma）的典型分佈。
features: Pale eosinophilic sheets and nests of cohesive tumor cells within the subcapsular and intranodal sinuses
Tumor partially replacing the nodal parenchyma, separating residual dark-blue lymphoid areas
Residual lymphoid follicle with a germinal center
Intact capsule with perinodal adipose tissue at the bottom
Cytologic detail of tumor cells not assessable at this magnification
2088.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows pale eosinophilic nests and sheets of cohesive cells filling the subcapsular and intranodal sinuses and extending into the parenchyma, with residual dark-staining lymphoid tissue and a follicle with a germinal center in between. The capsule is present with perinodal fat below. The sinusoidal distribution of a foreign cohesive population is typical of metastatic spread via afferent lymphatics, although tumor cytology cannot be evaluated at this power. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma to lymph node; cytokeratin immunostaining would confirm epithelial origin.

ddx.vs: Sinus histiocytosis contains bland, discohesive histiocytes that are CD68/CD163-positive and cytokeratin-negative.
ALCL cells are CD30+, often ALK+ and cytokeratin-negative, with hallmark kidney-shaped nuclei.
Melanoma can form sinusoidal nests but is S100/SOX10/HMB-45-positive and cytokeratin-negative, sometimes with pigment.

2920.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑間被大量小至中型、核圓或卵圓、細胞質稀少的腫瘤細胞取代，細胞呈流線狀排列於淡色纖維狀基質中；此視野以未分化的神經母細胞為主，看不到明確的大型節細胞。
features: Diffuse replacement of intertrabecular marrow by small to intermediate cells with round to oval hyperchromatic nuclei
Scant cytoplasm and high N:C ratio
Streaming and fascicle-like arrangement within pale fibrillary to fibrous stroma
Small clusters of darker, crushed cells
No normal hematopoiesis; definite ganglion cells not identified in this field
2920.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows trabecular bone with intertrabecular spaces diffusely replaced by small to intermediate-sized cells with round to oval hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm. The cells stream within pale fibrillary to collagenous stroma, and normal hematopoietic elements are absent. Mature ganglion cells with abundant cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli are not identified in this field, so the degree of post-chemotherapy differentiation cannot be judged from this image alone. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by metastatic neuroblastoma, with predominantly neuroblastic morphology in this field.

ddx.vs: Rhabdomyosarcoma may appear similar at this power but shows rhabdomyoblasts with eosinophilic cytoplasm and is myogenin/desmin positive.
Ewing cells are more uniform, sheet-like without fibrillary neuropil, and are CD99/NKX2.2 positive.
Lymphoblasts infiltrate diffusely without fibrillary stroma or streaming and are TdT positive.
Regenerating marrow contains recognizable erythroid islands and maturing myeloid cells rather than a monotonous infiltrate.

1256.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中散在大型細胞，細胞質內充滿大量藍黑色至墨綠色、細小粉末狀的色素顆粒（melanin），並溢出到背景中；周圍有許多中大型、染色質細緻、具核仁的非造血腫瘤細胞，符合黑色素瘤骨髓轉移。
features: Several large cells with cytoplasm packed with fine, dusty blue-black to green-black pigment granules (melanin)
Pigment granules also scattered extracellularly in the background
Many medium-to-large discohesive cells with round-to-oval nuclei, fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli, distinct from normal hematopoietic cells
Some cells with abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei (upper right)
Relatively few maturing myeloid or erythroid cells in this field
1256.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an infiltrate of medium-to-large, loosely cohesive non-hematopoietic-appearing cells with round-to-oval nuclei, fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli. Scattered large cells contain abundant fine, dusty blue-black cytoplasmic pigment, and similar pigment granules are dispersed in the background. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis is sparse in this field. Findings are suggestive of metastatic melanoma involving the bone marrow; confirmation with melanocytic markers (S100, SOX10, Melan-A, HMB45) on the core biopsy is recommended.

ddx.vs: Hemosiderin on Wright-Giemsa is coarser, golden-blue to blue-black and Prussian blue-positive, whereas melanin is finer, dusty and Fontana-Masson-positive with melanocytic marker-positive tumor cells.
Leukemic blasts lack cytoplasmic pigment and are CD45-positive with myeloid markers, whereas melanoma cells are CD45-negative and SOX10/S100-positive.
Basophil and mast cell granules are coarse, round and deep purple-black, obscure the nucleus, and are tryptase/CD117-positive rather than fine greenish-black melanin.
Pseudo-Chediak granules are large, discrete azurophilic inclusions within myeloid blasts, not dusty pigment in non-hematopoietic cells.

1192.recognize_zh: 淋巴組織中央有一個圓形、以粉紅色玻璃樣膠原呈同心圓層狀包繞的結構，中心僅殘留少數細胞與小血管，代表幾乎完全玻璃樣變的萎縮濾泡/血管，周圍為小淋巴球，符合 Castleman 病的高度玻璃樣變血管。
features: Round structure composed of concentric lamellae of dense eosinophilic hyalinized collagen
Center contains a few residual cells, including a small collapsed vessel/cell cluster
Artifactual clefts between hyalinized layers
Surrounding background of small mature lymphocytes and scattered plasma cells/histiocytes
Small interfollicular vessels in the adjacent tissue
1192.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a rounded structure composed of concentric lamellae of dense hyalinized eosinophilic collagen with only a few residual central cells, representing a markedly hyalinized vessel or completely regressed follicle. The surrounding tissue contains sheets of small mature lymphocytes without atypical large cells. The hyalinized structure lacks necrosis or granulomatous reaction. Findings are consistent with the prominent vascular hyalinization seen in hyaline-vascular Castleman disease.

ddx.vs: Amyloid is amorphous, pale, cracked and Congo red-positive with apple-green birefringence, not laminated collagen.

ddx.dx: Hyalinized granuloma or sclerosed vessel of other cause
ddx.vs: Old granulomas show peripheral epithelioid histiocytes or giant cells, and the context of onion-skin follicles supports Castleman disease rather than nonspecific sclerosis.

ddx.dx: Squamous keratin pearl of metastatic carcinoma
ddx.vs: Keratin pearls are brightly eosinophilic keratin with surrounding atypical keratinocytes, which are absent here.

1320.recognize_zh: 巨核細胞核呈濃縮、深染的大團塊，細胞質內包含數個完整的造血細胞（細胞穿入現象，emperipolesis），屬化療後骨髓中巨核細胞的變化。
features: Megakaryocyte with a large, dense, hyperchromatic, poorly lobated nuclear mass
Several intact hematopoietic cells (granulocytes) enclosed within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm (emperipolesis), each surrounded by a clear halo
Deeply basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm at the periphery
Background of maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors, and lymphocytes
1320.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a megakaryocyte with a dense, hyperchromatic, poorly lobated nucleus and basophilic cytoplasm containing several intact granulocytic cells within clear vacuoles, consistent with emperipolesis. The surrounding marrow cells include maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors. Emperipolesis itself is a nonspecific finding; in a post-chemotherapy marrow, the nuclear condensation and hypolobation are consistent with chemotherapy effect on megakaryocytes.

ddx.vs: In hemophagocytosis a histiocyte with a small bland nucleus engulfs and degrades cells, whereas here intact cells traverse the cytoplasm of a megakaryocyte with a large polyploid nucleus.
MDS megakaryocytic dysplasia is persistent, multilineage and clonal, and emperipolesis is not a dysplastic feature.

ddx.dx: Primary myelofibrosis or other MPN megakaryocytes
ddx.vs: MPN megakaryocytes are clustered with hyperlobated or cloud-like nuclei and emperipolesis in a biopsy context, with driver mutations (JAK2, CALR, MPL) rather than a therapy history.

1128.recognize_zh: 周邊血中有數個比小淋巴球大兩倍左右的芽細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、可見核仁，細胞質少而淡藍、無顆粒也無 Auer 小體；形態無系別特徵，需流式細胞儀判定為 AML 微分化型。
features: Medium to large blasts (about two times a small lymphocyte) with high N:C ratio
Round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm without Auer rods
Small mature lymphocyte present for size comparison
Many red cells contain small dark dots, likely stain precipitate or artifact
1128.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are not identified. A small mature lymphocyte is present for comparison. Small dark dots overlying many red cells are most likely stain precipitate. Findings are consistent with circulating blasts of acute leukemia; lineage cannot be determined morphologically, and flow cytometry is needed to support AML with minimal differentiation.

ddx.vs: ALL blasts can be morphologically identical and are distinguished by expression of B- or T-lineage markers on flow cytometry.
In AML without maturation at least 3% of blasts are MPO or Sudan black B positive, whereas AML-M0 blasts are below 3%.

ddx.dx: Blastoid mantle cell lymphoma in leukemic phase
ddx.vs: Blastoid MCL cells are CD5+, cyclin D1+ mature B cells lacking CD34 and TdT.

1064.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量前骨髓球與骨髓球，胞質含粗大深紫色顆粒、核旁有淡染 Golgi 區，後段成熟細胞少，屬左移並伴毒性顆粒的反應性變化；此視野未見神經母細胞瘤腫瘤細胞。
features: Predominance of promyelocytes and myelocytes with abundant cytoplasm
