Coarse, dark purple azurophilic granules throughout the cytoplasm, consistent with toxic-type granulation
Round to oval eccentric nuclei with fine to slightly condensed chromatin and perinuclear Golgi clearing
Occasional erythroblasts and few mature neutrophils; no Auer rods
No cohesive clusters of small round blue tumor cells in this field
1064.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows left-shifted granulopoiesis composed mainly of promyelocytes and myelocytes with coarse, darkly staining azurophilic granules and prominent Golgi zones. Mature neutrophils are relatively few, and occasional erythroid precursors are present. No Auer rods or clusters of metastatic tumor cells are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with reactive left-shifted myelopoiesis with toxic granulation; although the case is filed under metastatic neuroblastoma, tumor cells are not seen in this image and other fields/biopsy should be assessed.

ddx.vs: APL cells have bilobed or folded nuclei without a Golgi hof, may contain Auer rod bundles, and do not show maturation beyond the promyelocyte stage.
Morphology overlaps completely, so the distinction rests on clinical history of chemotherapy or growth factor administration.
Neuroblastoma appears as cohesive clusters or rosettes of small round cells with scant cytoplasm and neuropil, which are not present in this field.

4072.recognize_zh: 這是頸胸椎矢狀面 MRI，箭頭指向頸胸交界處脊椎管背側的異常訊號區，提示硬膜外或軟腦膜的病灶；在白血病病人中需考慮中樞神經系統侵犯或骨髓性肉瘤，但單張影像無法確診。
features: Sagittal MRI of the cervical and upper thoracic spine with posterior fossa included
Arrow indicates abnormal signal along the dorsal aspect of the spinal canal at the cervicothoracic junction
Vertebral bodies and cord outline visible; image quality limited by noise
Markedly hyperintense band posterior to the spine whose nature cannot be determined from this single image (possible artifact or soft-tissue fluid)
Single sequence without contrast information or axial correlation
4072.describe_en: Sagittal MRI of the cervical and upper thoracic spine is provided. The arrow points to abnormal signal along the dorsal aspect of the spinal canal at the cervicothoracic junction, which in a patient with acute myeloid leukemia raises concern for an epidural or leptomeningeal deposit (myeloid sarcoma / CNS leukemia). A prominent hyperintense band posterior to the spine cannot be characterized on this single sequence and may be artifactual. This is a non-morphologic image; diagnosis requires contrast-enhanced and axial imaging, CSF cytology with flow cytometry, and ideally tissue biopsy.

ddx.vs: Abscess shows peripheral rim enhancement with diffusion restriction and clinical signs of infection, and aspirate shows neutrophils and organisms rather than myeloid blasts.
Hematoma has blood-product signal evolution and is associated with thrombocytopenia or procedures, without enhancing solid tissue.
Epidural lymphoma or metastasis can look identical on MRI and is separated only by biopsy with immunophenotyping (MPO/CD33/CD117 for myeloid sarcoma).

3880.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中增加的中小型淋巴球，細胞質深藍且常有突起或泡狀邊緣（cytoplasmic blebs），細胞核略不規則，符合 T 細胞前淋巴球性白血病（T-PLL）。
features: Increased small to medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells
Deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with irregular protrusions/blebs
Round to irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Nucleoli not well resolved at this magnification
Occasional smudged/disrupted cells
Background echinocytes
3880.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an increased population of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and scant to moderate deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with frequent cytoplasmic protrusions. Occasional smudged cells are present, and red cells show crenation. Nucleoli are not well assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia; flow cytometry and TCL1 immunostaining or cytogenetics for inv(14)/t(14;14) are recommended.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are small with clumped soccer-ball chromatin, scant pale cytoplasm and numerous smudge cells, and are CD5/CD23/CD200 positive B cells.
Sézary cells show cerebriform nuclear folds with pale cytoplasm and usually lose CD7, whereas T-PLL cells have basophilic blebbed cytoplasm and are CD7 bright.
LGL cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and a cytotoxic CD8/CD57 phenotype.
Hairy cells have pale grey-blue cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections and oval to bean-shaped nuclei, and are B cells with BRAF V600E.

3944.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中，一群胞質豐富淡粉紅、核呈卵圓或拖鞋狀的上皮樣組織球聚在一起，箭頭指的是含多個核的多核巨細胞，周圍夾雜淋巴球，看不到壞死，符合非乾酪性肉芽腫。
features: Aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders
Oval to elongated, slipper-shaped vesicular nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Multinucleated giant cell (arrow) with several peripheral/clustered nuclei
Admixed small lymphocytes, plasma cells and occasional eosinophils at the periphery
No caseous necrosis in this field; adjacent fat spaces and hematopoietic cells
3944.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) at high power shows an aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval to slipper-shaped vesicular nuclei, including a multinucleated giant cell (arrow). Small lymphocytes, plasma cells and occasional eosinophils surround the aggregate. Necrosis is not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with a non-necrotizing epithelioid granuloma of the bone marrow; AFB and fungal stains, cultures and clinical correlation (infection, sarcoidosis, drugs, lymphoma) are recommended.

ddx.vs: Lipogranulomas are small, contain central lipid vacuoles surrounded by foamy macrophages and lymphocytes, and are usually incidental.
Hodgkin involvement shows Reed-Sternberg/Hodgkin cells with huge nucleoli that are CD30/CD15-positive among the histiocytes.
Megakaryocytes have a single hyperlobated nucleus and granular cytoplasm and lie among hematopoietic cells rather than within an epithelioid aggregate.

3624.recognize_zh: 免疫染色下整片腫瘤細胞呈強而一致的膜狀棕色陽性，細胞密集成片、幾乎沒有陰性背景，推測為 CD138 標示的漿細胞瘤片狀浸潤。
features: Diffuse sheet of tumor cells with strong, uniform membranous brown staining (presumed CD138)
Nearly all cells positive, with only scattered small negative areas
Cells round, closely packed, with hematoxylin-counterstained nuclei
Solid architecture without admixed normal tissue in this field
3624.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain, presumed CD138, shows a diffuse, solid sheet of tumor cells with strong and uniform membranous positivity involving virtually the entire field. There is no significant admixture of negative cells or residual normal tissue. The diffuse sheet-like positivity supports a neoplastic plasma cell proliferation; in an extramedullary site this is consistent with plasmacytoma, and kappa/lambda staining is needed to document clonality and exclude other CD138-positive tumors.

ddx.vs: Plasmablastic lymphoma is also CD138 positive but shows immunoblastic/plasmablastic cytology, Ki-67 >90%, and frequent EBER positivity.
Many carcinomas express CD138 but are keratin positive and lack immunoglobulin light-chain restriction.
This lymphoma is CD138 positive with plasmablastic features but shows granular cytoplasmic ALK staining.

3560.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血中有幾顆小到中型淋巴球，其中兩顆的核有凹陷或輕度分葉（花瓣狀傾向），細胞質少、呈淡藍色；異常細胞不多、紅血球正常，符合冒煙型成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤的輕微表現。
features: Small-to-intermediate lymphocytes with dense chromatin
Two cells with indented to mildly lobulated nuclei (incipient flower-cell morphology)
Scant pale-blue agranular cytoplasm
Low number of atypical cells in the field
Normochromic, normocytic RBCs; no significant poikilocytosis
Low magnification limits assessment of nuclear detail
3560.describe_en: Low-power peripheral blood smear shows a few small-to-intermediate lymphocytes, two of which have indented to mildly lobulated nuclei with dense chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm. Atypical cells are not numerous, and the red cells are unremarkable. Nuclear detail is limited at this magnification. In an HTLV-1-seropositive patient, findings are consistent with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, smoldering type, which requires at least 5% abnormal T cells with normal lymphocyte count, calcium, and LDH.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have finely grooved cerebriform nuclei, and patients are HTLV-1-negative with erythroderma.
Chronic type has absolute lymphocytosis of at least 4 x 10^9/L, whereas smoldering type has normal lymphocyte counts.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm and round nuclei and lack clonal HTLV-1 proviral integration.
Notched nuclei may be seen, but the cells are CD5+ cyclin D1+ B cells rather than CD4+CD25+ T cells.

3496.recognize_zh: 低倍關節液細胞離心抹片可見大量中性球與淋巴球、少數巨噬細胞，另有散在的均質粉紫色圓形小體；此倍率下 LE 細胞難以確認，需高倍尋找被吞入均質核物質的中性球。
features: Cellular cytospin with numerous neutrophils and lymphocytes
Scattered vacuolated macrophages, some containing ingested material
Occasional free round homogeneous pink-purple bodies in the background
Individual LE cells cannot be confidently identified at this low magnification
Clean background without crystals or organisms visible
3496.describe_en: Low-power cytospin of synovial fluid shows an inflammatory cell population composed of numerous neutrophils and lymphocytes with scattered vacuolated macrophages. A few round, homogeneous pink-purple bodies are present in the background and near phagocytes. At this magnification, LE cells (neutrophils containing a phagocytosed homogeneous nuclear mass) cannot be confidently identified, and higher-power examination is required. Findings are consistent with an inflammatory synovial effusion, and the homogeneous bodies raise the possibility of LE phenomenon in a patient with lupus.

ddx.vs: Septic fluid typically has overwhelming neutrophils (often >50,000/uL) with degenerative changes and intracellular bacteria, confirmed by Gram stain and culture.
Crystal disease shows needle- or rhomboid-shaped birefringent intracellular crystals under polarized light rather than homogeneous nuclear bodies.
Ragocytes contain multiple small dark refractile cytoplasmic granules, not a single large homogeneous nuclear mass.

3368.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中大片淡染、細胞質呈細泡沫/細顆粒狀的大型組織球取代造血組織，其間夾雜嗜酸性前驅細胞與紅系細胞，呈現骨髓組織球（泡沫細胞）浸潤。
features: Sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated (foamy/granular) cytoplasm
Histiocyte nuclei small, round to oval, eccentric, bland
Interspersed residual hematopoietic cells including eosinophilic precursors, erythroid cells and lymphocytes
Scattered extravasated red cells; delicate cell membranes outlining the histiocytes
No granulomas or overtly atypical cells seen
3368.describe_en: Bone marrow section shows extensive replacement of the intertrabecular space by sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated to foamy cytoplasm and small bland eccentric nuclei. Residual hematopoiesis, including eosinophilic precursors and erythroid cells, is interspersed. No granulomas or cytologically malignant cells are identified. Findings are consistent with marrow histiocytosis with storage-type (foamy) histiocytes; the differential includes lipid storage disorders and secondary (pseudo-) storage histiocytosis, and correlation with aspirate morphology, special stains (PAS, AFB, GMS) and enzyme studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have striated wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm rather than finely vacuolated foamy cytoplasm, and glucocerebrosidase activity is decreased.
Niemann-Pick foam cells have uniform soap-bubble vacuoles and sea-blue histiocytes show blue-green granules on Romanowsky stain, requiring aspirate and enzyme/genetic confirmation.
Infectious foamy histiocytes contain organisms demonstrable by AFB, PAS or GMS stains.
ECD shows foamy CD68+/CD1a- histiocytes with Touton giant cells and fibrosis, often with BRAF V600E, and characteristic long bone sclerosis radiologically.

3432.recognize_zh: 整片密集排列的中到大型非典型淋巴樣細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少且偏嗜鹼性，部分可見小空泡，並夾雜許多被擠破、呈洋紅色的裸核；缺乏典型裂核（cleaved nuclei），符合「形態不典型」的周邊化濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Dense population of intermediate to large atypical lymphoid cells, larger than admixed red cells
High N:C ratio with round to slightly irregular nuclei; nuclear clefts are not conspicuous
Fine to moderately condensed chromatin with occasional small nucleoli
Scant basophilic cytoplasm, some cells with small cytoplasmic vacuoles
Numerous disrupted cells with smeared magenta chromatin (smudge/crush artifact)
Monotonous lymphoid population without granulocytes in this field
3432.describe_en: A highly cellular, concentrated smear preparation (presumably peripheral blood/buffy coat) shows a monotonous population of intermediate to large atypical lymphoid cells. The cells have high N:C ratios, round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine to moderately condensed chromatin, occasional small nucleoli, and scant basophilic cytoplasm that is focally vacuolated. Numerous disrupted cells with smeared magenta chromatin are admixed. Classic small cleaved (buttock) cells are not evident, so the morphology overlaps with blastoid lymphoma and leukemia. In the given clinical context, findings are consistent with leukemic involvement by follicular lymphoma with atypical (large/blastoid-appearing) morphology; flow cytometry (CD10+, surface light chain restriction) and BCL2/IGH studies are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts have finer, more homogeneous chromatin and are TdT/CD34 positive with dim or absent surface immunoglobulin, whereas FL cells are TdT-negative with surface light chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of blastoid mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical; cyclin D1/SOX11 expression and CCND1 rearrangement separate MCL from CD10+ BCL2-rearranged FL.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Transformed disease may look similar; FISH for MYC in addition to BCL2 and a high Ki-67 fraction are needed to exclude it.
Myeloblasts often show azurophilic granules or Auer rods and are MPO/CD33/CD117 positive, unlike the agranular, B-marker positive FL cells.

3304.recognize_zh: 觸片（touch prep）上四顆原始細胞緊貼成簇，核質比極高、幾乎看不到細胞質，核圓至有凹陷、染色質均勻細緻，無顆粒；背景呈粉紫色蛋白質並散布許多透明脂肪空泡，符合急性淋巴芽細胞白血病的觸片表現，但費城染色體無法靠形態判斷。
features: Cluster of four blasts with very high N:C ratio and barely visible rim of cytoplasm
Round to slightly angulated nuclei with a small indentation in one cell
Finely dispersed, homogeneous chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods
Background of pink-purple proteinaceous material with numerous clear lipid vacuoles, typical of a touch imprint
3304.describe_en: Touch imprint preparation shows a cluster of four blasts in a pink-purple proteinaceous background containing numerous clear lipid vacuoles. The blasts have very high N:C ratios with only a thin rim of cytoplasm, round to slightly indented nuclei, finely dispersed homogeneous chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. No granules or Auer rods are seen; the vacuoles lie in the background rather than within blast cytoplasm. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; BCR::ABL1 (Philadelphia chromosome) status cannot be determined morphologically and requires cytogenetic or molecular testing.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML blasts may be agranular but are MPO or CD13/CD33/CD117 positive and negative for TdT with B-cell markers.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with intracytoplasmic punched-out vacuoles and are TdT-negative with surface light chains.
Blast morphology is identical; a prior chronic phase, basophilia or BCR::ABL1 in myeloid lineages indicate CML blast phase.
Hematogones are heterogeneous with a maturation continuum on flow cytometry and do not form monotonous clusters of blasts.

3240.recognize_zh: 數顆巨大的巨核細胞彼此相鄰聚集，核呈膨大、深染、團塊狀的雲朵形（cloud-like）或氣球狀分葉，細胞質豐富，周圍夾雜成群的紅血球前驅細胞，是 PMF 異型巨核細胞群聚的典型表現。
features: Clusters of large megakaryocytes lying adjacent to each other and near a fat space
Bulbous, hyperchromatic, clumped 'cloud-like' nuclei with abnormal lobulation
Some megakaryocytes with high N:C ratio and irregularly folded nuclei
Abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Intervening erythroid islands with dense round nuclei and scattered eosinophilic myelocytes
3240.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a hypercellular marrow containing clusters of large, atypical megakaryocytes adjacent to fat spaces. The megakaryocytes have bulbous, hyperchromatic, clumped cloud-like nuclei with abnormal lobulation, and some show an increased N:C ratio. Erythroid islands and granulocytic precursors fill the spaces between clusters. Findings are consistent with the atypical clustered megakaryocytic proliferation characteristic of primary myelofibrosis; reticulin staining and driver mutation analysis are recommended.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are giant with deeply hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei and mature chromatin, loosely dispersed without hyperchromatic clumped nuclei.
PV has panmyelosis with pleomorphic megakaryocytes of varying size but generally normal chromatin and lacks the dense hyperchromatic cloud-like forms.
MDS megakaryocytes are small, hypolobated or with widely separated nuclei, accompanied by dyserythropoiesis and dysgranulopoiesis.
Tumor giant cells form cohesive keratin-positive clusters with nucleoli and lack megakaryocytic CD61/CD42b expression.

3176.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中可見多顆異常淋巴細胞，核深染且呈不規則分葉或卷曲，細胞質少，數量明顯增加，符合 ATLL 周邊血侵犯；個別核的花瓣狀細節需高倍確認。
features: Increased numbers of atypical lymphoid cells in a low-power field
Irregular, lobulated or convoluted, hyperchromatic nuclei
Scant basophilic cytoplasm with high N:C ratio
Mild variation in cell size among the atypical lymphoid cells
Normochromic, normocytic red cells with scattered platelets
3176.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows an increased number of atypical lymphoid cells with hyperchromatic, irregularly lobulated nuclei and scant cytoplasm. Red cells are normochromic and normocytic, and platelets are present. The magnification limits evaluation of fine nuclear detail, but the nuclear irregularity and lymphocytosis are evident. Findings are consistent with leukemic involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, to be confirmed by higher-power review, HTLV-1 serology and flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells have finely cerebriform nuclei and occur with erythroderma, and are HTLV-1 negative.
CLL cells have round nuclei with clumped chromatin and frequent smudge cells rather than lobulated nuclei.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm hugging red cells rather than uniform lobulated nuclei with scant cytoplasm.
FL cells are small with deeply cleaved nuclei and are CD10+ BCL2+ B cells rather than CD4+ CD25+ T cells.

3048.recognize_zh: 低中倍周邊血抹片中淋巴球明顯增多，多為核濃縮、帶切口或裂溝的小型淋巴球，對照視野中央唯一一個嗜中性球，顯示絕對淋巴球增多，符合百日咳。
features: Increased lymphocytes, clearly outnumbering the single neutrophil in the field
Predominantly small lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm
Irregular nuclear contours with clefts and indentations; dense mature chromatin
Occasional slightly larger lymphocyte with more cytoplasm; no blasts
Normocytic RBCs and normal platelets
3048.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at medium power shows a relative and apparent absolute lymphocytosis, with numerous lymphocytes and only one neutrophil in the field. Most lymphocytes are small, with scant cytoplasm and hyperchromatic nuclei showing clefts or indentations; a few are slightly larger with more cytoplasm. No blasts, smudge cells, or atypical large lymphoid cells are identified, and red cells and platelets appear normal. Findings are suggestive of the reactive small-lymphocyte lymphocytosis of Bordetella pertussis infection.

ddx.vs: CLL shows monotonous round lymphocytes with smudge cells in older adults and a clonal CD5+/CD23+ B-cell population on flow cytometry.
Lymphoblasts have fine chromatin, nucleoli, and often cytopenias, whereas these lymphocytes have mature condensed chromatin.

ddx.dx: Leukemic mantle cell or follicular lymphoma
ddx.vs: These adult lymphomas have clonal B cells (cyclin D1+ or CD10+), while pertussis lymphocytosis is polyclonal, T-cell rich, and pediatric.

2984.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片顯示細胞量豐富的骨髓顆粒（particle），可見數顆巨核細胞與脂肪空泡；此倍率無法看到巨大顆粒，只能評估細胞密度。
features: Highly cellular marrow particle with abundant hematopoietic cells
Scattered megakaryocytes present
A few fat vacuoles within the particle
Individual cytoplasmic granules not resolvable at low power
2984.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a highly cellular particle composed of a mixed hematopoietic population with scattered megakaryocytes and few fat spaces. Cellular detail, including cytoplasmic granules, cannot be assessed at this magnification. The field documents adequate, cellular aspirate material; diagnostic giant granules of Chediak-Higashi syndrome require examination at high power.

ddx.vs: Separated only at high power by normal granule morphology and orderly maturation.
Leukemia shows a monotonous blast population at higher magnification rather than mixed maturing cells.

2856.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中出現多顆漿細胞：核偏位、染色質呈車輪狀、細胞質深藍並有核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof），數量明顯多於其他白血球，符合漿細胞白血病。
features: Multiple circulating plasma cells in a single low-power field
Eccentric round nuclei with clumped chromatin
Moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing (hof)
Plasma cells outnumber the few neutrophils present
Background red cells without prominent rouleaux in this field
2856.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous circulating plasma cells, which outnumber the neutrophils in this field. The cells have eccentric round nuclei with clumped chromatin and moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing. Background red cells show no prominent rouleaux in this field. Findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia, which requires ≥5% circulating plasma cells (per current criteria) and should be confirmed by flow cytometry showing clonal CD38/CD138-positive plasma cells.

ddx.vs: Reactive circulating plasma cells are few, accompanied by reactive lymphocytes, and are polytypic by light-chain analysis.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with MYD88 L265P, rather than a uniform plasma cell population.
Reactive lymphocytes have central nuclei, less distinct hof and cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells.

2792.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫染色中，一個邊界不清、沿脂肪空泡延伸的淋巴球聚集有許多棕色陽性小淋巴球，周圍間質也散在陽性細胞；抗體未標示，推測為 T 細胞標記，顯示聚集以 T 細胞為主。
features: Loosely formed, ill-defined lymphoid aggregate adjacent to a trabecula
Numerous small positive lymphocytes with membranous/cytoplasmic brown staining
Many scattered positive cells throughout the interstitium
Weak background staining in some areas
Negative hematopoietic precursors; prominent fat spaces
2792.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on a bone marrow core biopsy highlights a loosely organized lymphoid aggregate near a trabecula composed of numerous positive small lymphocytes, with many additional positive cells scattered in the interstitium. Background hematopoietic cells are negative, and there is mild nonspecific background staining. The antibody is not labeled; the pattern is compatible with a T-cell marker highlighting a T-cell rich aggregate and increased interstitial T cells. In the post-rituximab setting, this supports rituximab-associated marrow T-cell hyperplasia rather than residual B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Residual lymphoma would show a PAX5/CD79a-positive B-cell aggregate, sometimes with CD20 loss after rituximab.
T-LGL shows intrasinusoidal linear clusters of CD8+/TIA-1+/granzyme B+ cells rather than a nodular aggregate.
PTCL shows atypical medium-to-large T cells with antigen loss and TCR clonality.

2792.stain: IHC: likely T-cell marker (antibody not labeled)

2408.recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的骨髓中可見數顆大型細胞，細胞質豐富、帶嗜雙性，核偏位、染色質呈車輪狀或具核仁，並有核周淡染區，混在較小的造血細胞之間，符合骨髓瘤的大型漿細胞。
features: Scattered large cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei
Nuclei round with vesicular to clock-face chromatin and visible nucleoli
Perinuclear clearing (hof) in some cells
Admixed eosinophilic granulocytes, erythroid precursors and small lymphoid cells
Adjacent bony trabecula and edematous stroma with a dilated sinusoid
2408.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy (H&E) shows paratrabecular and interstitial marrow containing scattered large cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, eccentric round nuclei with vesicular chromatin and visible nucleoli, and focal perinuclear clearing. These cells are admixed with maturing granulocytes, eosinophils, and erythroid precursors adjacent to a dilated sinusoid and a bony trabecula. The morphology is consistent with large atypical plasma cells. CD138 and kappa/lambda staining are recommended to quantify the infiltrate and confirm clonality; findings are suggestive of plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small, mature, perivascular and polytypic by kappa/lambda staining, lacking large nucleolated forms.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P and IgM paraprotein rather than large atypical plasma cells alone.
Osteoblasts line the trabecular surface in a row and are CD138 and light chain negative.

2344.recognize_zh: 高倍下細胞間是淡紫紅色、帶細纖維狀條紋的膠狀基質，勾勒出數個大型空洞輪廓（萎縮脂肪細胞），其間只有零星淋巴球、中性球與紅血球，是骨髓膠狀轉化的細部表現。
features: Pale violet, finely fibrillar extracellular ground substance with streaming strands
Large rounded pale spaces outlined by matrix, consistent with atrophic fat cells
Sparse isolated nucleated cells: small lymphocyte-like cells and an occasional segmented neutrophil
Red cells embedded in the matrix, some appearing elongated or distorted
A small granular purple cluster within the matrix, likely degenerated cell or platelet debris
2344.describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow aspirate shows a loose, pale violet, finely fibrillar extracellular matrix outlining large rounded clear spaces consistent with atrophic adipocytes. Nucleated hematopoietic cells are very sparse and include isolated small lymphocytes and an occasional neutrophil, with scattered red cells trapped in the matrix. No abnormal or blastic population is identified. Findings are consistent with gelatinous transformation (serous fat atrophy) of the marrow, as seen in anorexia nervosa.

ddx.vs: Amyloid is more homogeneous and waxy, often perivascular, and Congo red positive, unlike this loose fibrillar Alcian blue-positive matrix.
Myelofibrosis produces a dry tap with fibroblast-like cells and reticulin/collagen on biopsy rather than a mucoid matrix around atrophic fat cells.
Necrotic marrow contains shadowy necrotic cells and granular debris rather than intact scattered cells in an acellular matrix.

2280.recognize_zh: 數顆中大型母細胞，圓形核佔滿細胞、染色質細緻均勻，只有一圈淡藍色少量細胞質，無顆粒；其中一顆核緣不規則並有摺痕，屬淋巴母細胞形態，是否為 T 細胞系需靠免疫表型。
features: Medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Round nuclei with finely granular, evenly dispersed chromatin; one with irregular, convoluted nuclear edge
Inconspicuous nucleoli
Thin rim of scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm, one with a small cytoplasmic vacuole
Sparse background with few red cells and faint proteinaceous material
2280.describe_en: Smear shows a small group of medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and a thin rim of scant agranular pale blue cytoplasm. One blast shows an irregular, convoluted nuclear contour and another a small cytoplasmic vacuole. The background is sparse, so the specimen type and overall cellularity cannot be assessed from this field. Findings are consistent with lymphoblasts; T-lineage requires immunophenotypic confirmation.

ddx.vs: B-lymphoblasts look the same and require flow cytometry (CD19, CD10, CD79a) to separate from T-lymphoblasts (cytoplasmic CD3, CD7).
Agranular myeloblasts overlap morphologically but are MPO or CD13/CD33/CD117 positive by flow cytometry.
ETP-ALL is morphologically similar and is defined by immunophenotype (CD1a and CD8 negative, CD5 weak, stem/myeloid markers positive).

1960.recognize_zh: 以綠色 methyl green 複染的切片中，散在少數細胞核呈深藍黑色的原位雜交陽性訊號（EBER），陽性細胞大小不一，其中數顆為較大的細胞，其餘大多數腫瘤細胞為陰性，符合 AITL 中散在 EBV 陽性 B 細胞的表現。
features: Scattered cells with dense dark blue-black nuclear hybridization signal
Positive cells vary from small to large, some with irregular or immunoblast-sized nuclei
Positive cells represent a small minority of the infiltrate
Majority of lymphoid cells negative, with green nuclear counterstain and occasional clear/pale nuclei
No cytoplasmic or membranous signal, consistent with nuclear EBER localization
1960.describe_en: In situ hybridization for EBV-encoded RNA (EBER; presumed from the nuclear chromogenic signal with methyl green counterstain) shows scattered positive nuclei of variable size, including several large immunoblast-sized cells, within a predominantly negative lymphoid infiltrate. The positive cells constitute a small minority of the population. In a lymph node with the histology and TFH immunophenotype of angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma, these findings are consistent with scattered EBV-positive B cells, a characteristic feature of that entity.

ddx.vs: EBV-positive DLBCL shows sheets of EBER-positive large B cells rather than scattered positive cells in a negative T-cell background.
In cHL the EBER-positive cells are Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells that are CD30/CD15-positive with weak PAX5, not a spectrum of small to large B cells.
Reactive EBV lymphadenitis has numerous EBER-positive cells in a preserved architecture without clonal TFH T cells.
In NK/T-cell lymphoma essentially all neoplastic cells are EBER-positive with an angiocentric, necrotic pattern.

1896.recognize_zh: 低中倍脾臟切片可見紅髓被小型、核圓至腎形、細胞質淡染的單一細胞群瀰漫浸潤，其間散布大小不一的血湖（blood lakes），未見白髓結節，符合毛狀細胞白血病的紅髓浸潤型態。
features: Diffuse red pulp infiltrate without identifiable white pulp nodules
Monotonous small cells with oval to reniform nuclei and bland chromatin
Pale cytoplasm producing evenly spaced nuclei
Multiple red blood cell lakes (pseudosinuses) lined by tumor cells
Congested cords with abundant extravasated erythrocytes
1896.describe_en: Section of spleen shows diffuse infiltration of the red pulp by a monotonous population of small lymphoid cells with oval to bean-shaped nuclei and pale cytoplasm, imparting an evenly spaced appearance. Numerous irregular red cell lakes lined by the infiltrating cells are present. White pulp follicles are not seen in this field, and there is no sheet of large cells. Findings are consistent with splenic involvement by hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: SMZL is white-pulp-centered with nodular biphasic architecture and lacks blood lakes, and is annexin A1/CD103/BRAF V600E negative.
Mast cell infiltrates are often perivascular/trabecular with fibrosis and eosinophils, and are tryptase and CD117 positive rather than CD20/annexin A1 positive.
Congestion shows dilated sinuses with a normal cellular composition of the cords and preserved white pulp, without a monotonous lymphoid infiltrate.

1768.recognize_zh: 教學投影片：左上H&E以中小型、核不規則的腫瘤細胞為主，間雜少數較大的hallmark細胞；右上CD30染色顯示大細胞強陽性且聚集於血管周圍，小細胞多為陰性；右下H&E為轉變後成片的大細胞，符合小細胞型間變性大細胞淋巴瘤及其大細胞轉化。
features: Composite teaching slide titled 'Small Cell Predominant ALCL' with three photomicrographs and the label 'Large cell transformation'
Upper left H&E: predominance of small to medium cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei and clear cytoplasm, with scattered larger atypical cells
Upper right CD30: strong staining concentrated in larger cells clustering in a band, likely around a vessel, with many small cells negative
Lower right H&E: sheet of monotonous large cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, representing large cell transformation
Image resolution limits assessment of individual nuclear contours
1768.describe_en: This composite teaching slide shows an infiltrate composed predominantly of small to medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular nuclei and clear cytoplasm, with scattered larger hallmark-like cells. A CD30 immunostain highlights predominantly the larger cells, which cluster in a perivascular band, while many small neoplastic cells are weak or negative. A separate panel shows sheets of large cells with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, representing large cell transformation. Findings are consistent with the small cell pattern of ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma with progression to the common large cell pattern; ALK staining (often nuclear-restricted in small cells) aids diagnosis.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS lacks perivascular clustering of strongly CD30-positive hallmark cells and is ALK negative.
Reactive immunoblasts show variable weaker CD30 staining in a polymorphous background without cytologic atypia of the small cells, and are ALK negative.
Hodgkin lymphoma has scattered Reed-Sternberg cells that are CD15+ and weak PAX5+, rather than atypical T cells with ALK positivity.

1704.recognize_zh: 這張骨髓抹片看到的是各階段混合的造血細胞：成熟中的顆粒球（帶狀核、分葉核）、深染圓核的紅血球前驅細胞、少數較大的早期細胞，並未見成片單調的母細胞，型態與「雙表型急性白血病」標題不完全吻合，可能為治療後或殘存正常造血區域。
features: Mixed marrow cell population rather than a monotonous blast sheet
Maturing granulocytes including bands and segmented neutrophils
Numerous erythroid precursors with small, round, dense nuclei (orthochromatic/polychromatic normoblasts)
Scattered larger immature cells with fine chromatin and moderate cytoplasm, not forming a dominant population
Background of red cells and several fat vacuoles
1704.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixed population of hematopoietic cells, including maturing granulocytes (bands and segmented forms), abundant erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei, and scattered larger immature cells with fine chromatin. Fat vacuoles and red cells are present in the background. A monotonous population of blasts is not seen in this field, so the image does not by itself demonstrate acute leukemia as the title implies; it may represent a regenerating or post-treatment marrow or a less-involved area. A formal blast count and flow cytometric assessment for residual disease are required.

ddx.vs: Shows orderly trilineage recovery with erythroid and granulocytic maturation, as in this field, and blasts below 5% on count and MRD flow.
Would show a discrete population of blasts on a differential count and an aberrant immunophenotype on flow cytometry, not evident morphologically here.
Would show dysplastic features such as megaloblastoid erythroid nuclei, hypogranular neutrophils or micromegakaryocytes, which are not clearly seen.

1640.recognize_zh: 中央有一個淡染的淋巴濾泡，內含核較大、染色質開放的細胞與粉紅色間質，外圍環繞一圈深染的小淋巴球（mantle zone），左側有厚壁粉紅色血管，呈現正常次級濾泡的分層結構。
features: Nodule with a pale center of medium-to-large cells with vesicular nuclei and eosinophilic stroma/dendritic cell cytoplasm
Surrounding rim of densely packed small dark lymphocytes (mantle zone)
Outer zone of slightly paler small-to-medium lymphocytes
Thick-walled eosinophilic vessels at the left edge
No monotonous atypical population
1640.describe_en: Section of lymphoid tissue at medium power shows a follicle with a pale center composed of medium-to-large cells with vesicular nuclei and eosinophilic stroma, surrounded by a rim of dense small lymphocytes and an outer paler zone. Thick-walled vessels are present at the left edge. The layered arrangement is preserved and there is no cytologic atypia. In the context of this series, findings are consistent with a normal secondary follicle, likely splenic white pulp.

ddx.vs: Hyaline-vascular Castleman shows regressed germinal centers penetrated by hyalinized radial vessels with onion-skin mantles, whereas this center is cellular without a penetrating lollipop vessel.
Neoplastic follicles lack a well-defined mantle and polarization and are BCL2 positive, while this follicle has a distinct mantle rim.
SMZL shows markedly expanded marginal zones around residual or colonized follicles, not the thin normal outer zone seen here.

1448.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中兩顆巨核細胞體積大、細胞質豐富呈細顆粒狀，但細胞核為單一圓形或卵圓形且偏向一側（non-lobated, eccentric），不分葉，是 del(5q) MDS 的典型巨核細胞型態。
features: Two large megakaryocytes with abundant finely granular pink-purple cytoplasm
Nuclei are single, round to oval, non-lobated and eccentrically placed
Relatively low N:C ratio compared with the overall cell size (not micromegakaryocytes)
Nuclear chromatin moderately condensed without lobulation or separated nuclear fragments
Platelet clumps and scattered platelets in the background; a small neutrophil-lineage cell at top
1448.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two large megakaryocytes with abundant granular cytoplasm. Both contain a single round to oval, non-lobated nucleus placed eccentrically, in contrast to the normal multilobated megakaryocyte nucleus. Adjacent platelets and platelet clumps are present. Monolobated, non-lobated megakaryocytes of normal to slightly reduced size are characteristic of myelodysplastic syndrome with isolated del(5q), and the findings are consistent with that diagnosis in conjunction with karyotype confirmation.

ddx.dx: Micromegakaryocytes of other MDS types or CML
ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes are small (lymphocyte to promyelocyte size) with scant cytoplasm, whereas del(5q) megakaryocytes are normal-sized with abundant cytoplasm and a single round nucleus.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocytes with separated nuclear lobes (MDS, HIV, drug effect)
ddx.vs: Those show multiple discrete, round nuclear fragments rather than one smooth round nucleus.
ET megakaryocytes are large to giant with hyperlobulated, staghorn nuclei rather than non-lobated nuclei.
Immature megakaryocytes have deeply basophilic, less granular cytoplasm and a higher N:C ratio, whereas these cells have mature granular cytoplasm despite a non-lobated nucleus.

1512.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中漿細胞明顯增加；箭頭所指為漿細胞細胞質內淡灰藍色、圓形均質的球狀包涵體（Russell bodies），將細胞核推向一側，是免疫球蛋白堆積的表現，搭配大量核偏位的漿細胞支持骨髓瘤。
features: Increased plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm
Arrows: round, homogeneous, pale gray-blue cytoplasmic globules (Russell bodies) within plasma cells
Some plasma cells large with less condensed chromatin (immature forms)
Admixed granulocytes and small dark erythroid precursors
Thick smear area with overlapping cells and brown-staining red cells
1512.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm, some large with less condensed chromatin. Several plasma cells contain round, homogeneous, pale gray-blue cytoplasmic globules consistent with Russell bodies (arrows). Maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors are admixed. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm (multiple myeloma) in the stated context, although Russell bodies themselves are not specific for malignancy; plasma cell percentage and clonality should be confirmed.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, usually <10% of marrow cells and polytypic, even when Russell bodies are present.
LPL shows a mixture of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells, with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.

ddx.dx: Cytoplasmic vacuoles (e.g., Burkitt or toxic changes)
ddx.vs: Vacuoles are clear, empty spaces, whereas Russell bodies are homogeneous, lightly stained protein globules.
Macrophages have abundant pale cytoplasm with heterogeneous debris and a non-eccentric nucleus without a perinuclear hof.

104.recognize_zh: 這不是形態學圖：一張為男童雙膝腫脹（左膝明顯）的臨床照片，提示反覆關節出血；另一張為 inverse shift PCR 洋菜膠電泳，可見 559 bp 與 487 bp 不同大小的條帶，用來判定 F8 基因 intron 22 倒位（Inv22）與帶因者狀態。
features: Clinical photo: bilateral knee swelling in a child, more marked on one side, without visible overlying skin lesions
Agarose gel with a DNA ladder (lane 2; 500 bp band brightest) and six sample lanes
Single band at about 559 bp in lane 1 and a similar-sized band in lane 5 (inversion-type product size)
Single band at 487 bp in lane 7 (normal/wild-type product size)
Lanes 3 and 6 show a main band with additional fainter bands, a pattern that may indicate two alleles (carrier) but cannot be assigned without the lane legend
104.describe_en: Figure 1 is a clinical photograph of a boy showing swelling of both knees, more pronounced on one side, consistent with hemarthrosis or hemophilic arthropathy. Figure 2 is an ethidium-stained 2% agarose gel of inverse shift PCR products for the F8 intron 22 inversion, with a size ladder in lane 2. Discrete bands of about 559 bp (inversion-associated) and 487 bp (normal allele) are seen in different lanes, and some lanes show more than one band suggesting heterozygosity; lane-to-family-member assignment is not labeled on the image itself. In the clinical context (aPTT prolongation correcting on mixing, factor VIII <1%, normal VWF antigen), the findings support severe hemophilia A due to Inv22, with a hemizygous proband, carrier mother and affected fetus.

ddx.vs: Clinically and on aPTT/mixing studies it is identical, so separation requires a factor IX assay and F9 sequencing rather than Inv22 testing.

ddx.dx: Type 2N or type 3 von Willebrand disease
ddx.vs: Low factor VIII can result from defective VWF binding (2N) or absent VWF (type 3), distinguished by VWF antigen/activity and FVIII-binding assays, which were normal here.
An inhibitor produces an aPTT that fails to correct or corrects then prolongs on incubated mixing and is confirmed by Bethesda assay, whereas this aPTT corrected.

captions: Clinical photo: bilateral knee swelling (hemarthrosis/hemophilic arthropathy)
Inverse shift PCR agarose gel for F8 intron 22 inversion (559 bp vs 487 bp products)

4008.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑間的造血區由一致性的小型深染圓形細胞瀰漫佔據，脂肪細胞間穿插，正常三系混合及巨核細胞明顯減少；需高倍與 TdT/CD19/CD34 確認復發的前驅 B 淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: Bone marrow core with bony trabeculae and moderate cellularity (~50–60%) between adipocytes
Interstitial to sheet-like replacement by monotonous small, dark, round nuclei
Loss of normal trilineage heterogeneity; megakaryocytes markedly reduced (single megakaryocyte at upper right)
Individual blast cytology not assessable at this low magnification
4008.describe_en: Low-power bone marrow core biopsy shows trabecular bone with intertrabecular marrow of moderate cellularity. The hematopoietic space is diffusely populated by a monotonous infiltrate of small, dark, round nuclei with loss of the normal mixed trilineage pattern, and megakaryocytes are markedly reduced. Cytologic detail is not assessable at this power. In a patient with prior precursor B-lymphoblastic leukemia, the findings are consistent with relapsed disease, pending higher-power review and TdT, CD34, CD19 and PAX5 immunostains or flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Hematogones are a heterogeneous, maturation-spectrum B-cell population admixed with normal trilineage hematopoiesis on flow, not a monotonous sheet effacing megakaryopoiesis.
Myeloblasts usually have more cytoplasm and are MPO-positive and TdT/PAX5-negative on immunostains.

ddx.dx: Marrow involvement by small B-cell lymphoma (e.g., CLL)
ddx.vs: Mature lymphoma cells have condensed chromatin, often form paratrabecular or nodular aggregates, and are TdT/CD34-negative.

3752.recognize_zh: G-CSF 刺激後的周邊血幹細胞收集物抹片，整群是左移的顆粒球系細胞：骨髓球、後骨髓球、帶狀核球，胞質有粗大的紫紅色毒性樣顆粒與小空泡，看不到芽細胞群聚，屬於藥物刺激下的反應性變化。
features: Cluster of left-shifted granulocytic cells: myelocytes, metamyelocytes, and band forms
Kidney-shaped to indented nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Cytoplasm with coarse dark purple-red (toxic-like) granulation
Small cytoplasmic vacuoles in several cells
Occasional cells with basophilic cytoplasm and blebs; scattered platelets and few red cells
No discrete population of blasts identified
3752.describe_en: Smear of an apheresis collection obtained after G-CSF administration shows a concentrated population of granulocytic cells spanning myelocytes, metamyelocytes, and band neutrophils. Many cells display coarse, toxic-appearing azurophilic granulation and small cytoplasmic vacuoles, and a few show basophilic cytoplasm with blebbing. Scattered platelets and occasional red cells are present, and no increase in blasts is evident. Findings are consistent with G-CSF effect with a left-shifted granulocytic population and toxic granulation.

ddx.vs: CML shows a myelocyte bulge with basophilia and eosinophilia and BCR::ABL1, whereas G-CSF effect has a clinical history of growth factor and lacks basophilia.
Infection can produce identical toxic granulation, vacuolation, and left shift, so separation depends on clinical history of G-CSF administration.
APL shows hypergranular promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and Auer rod bundles and PML::RARA, rather than a full maturation spectrum.
